tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa dpag bsam ljon shing la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing la 'jug pa/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 'dod pa'i 'ching las grol yang rtag tu 'dod chags chen pos gang*/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam pa bral yang rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan/ / tshig tu brjod pa kun las grol yang 'gro kun skad kyis chos rab ston/ /gcig dang du ma'i gzugs dang bral yang sna tshogs gzugs mang ston la 'dud/ /gang zhig brten na srid dang grol ba yi/ /dpal kun rab ster rim gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs/ /kun mkhyen ches mdzad dpag bsam ljon shing las/ / ngag 'don 'bras bu ci nus bsdus te bshad/ /'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la/ rgyud sbyang ba thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ nges par bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid sgrub thabs nyams len gyi skabs su nges par dgos pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gsum mo/ /de yang*/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/

/byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /oṃ swa bhā wa <rang bzhin > shuddhāḥ <dag pa rnams > sarba dharmāḥ <chos rnams thams cad > swa bhā ba shuddho3haṃ/ <rang bzhin dag pa'i bdag go/> stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang padma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa a hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/

/ bla ma mgon po skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ / 'khor ba thogs ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur pa bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ye shes rdo rje rnams dbyer med du gyur/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu ni/ rdo rje'i zhal dag rigs drug dgod pa dang*/ /rdo rje bzhi dang yan lag drug rnams 'god/ /bdud tshogs gzhom zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom/ /mkha' la rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams rtogs bya ste/ /bla med mchod pa rnam pa bdun gyis mchod/ / lam bsten stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ pradzñā u pā ya ātma ka <shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid > kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā na <sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi > a dhi pa te/ <mnga' bdag > ma ma kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā na badzraṃ/ <bdag gi lus ngag sems ye shes rdo rje > badzra a mṛ ta swa bhā waṃ/ <rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du mdzod mdzod > ku ru ku ru skandha dhā tu ā ya ta naṃ niḥ <phung po khams skye mched rnams > swa bhā waṃ swāhā/ <rang bzhin med pa'i gzhi tshugs shig3gt; lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtsug tor gyi steng du waṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de zhu ba lus la zhugs pas/ gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi mthar thug pa'i ma dag pa'i lus sprul gyi shun pa ltar lan gsum du dor te/ lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes rnam par dag pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba dri ma med pa ltar gyur/

gnyis pa rigs drug dgod pa ni/ oṃ <rang bzhin dag pa rnams chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin dag pa'i bdag go/> swa bhā wa shuddhaḥ sarba dharmāḥ swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po las snang ba mtha' yas dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po las rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ snying gar hūṃ nag po las don yod grub pa nag po/ lte bar hoḥser po las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ gtsug tor du haṃ ljang khu las mi bskyod pa ljang khu/ gsang bar kṣaḥsngon po las rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po rnams zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ so sor dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pa rnams 'khod par gyur/ gsum pa rdo rje bzhi dag pa ni/ lag pa phan tshun mnye zhing bkru ba'i phyag rgya byas nas/ oṃ hraḥsarba ast+ra rā dza <thams cad mtshon cha'i rgyal po > mā ra kle sha anta ka ra/ <bdud dang nyon mongs pa mthar byed pa > badzra tīkṣ+ṇa <rdo rje rnon po > duḥkha <sdug bsngal > tstshe da <gcod pa > mā ma ka raṃ bi sho dha ya <bdag gi lag pa rnam par sbyongs/> swāhā/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ a i ṛ u l̥/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ a e ar o al/ steng gi tshigs rnams su/ ha ya ra wa la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su/ lā wā rā yā hā/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ āl au ār ai ā/ rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su hūṃ gi yi ge mthon mthing*/ zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag las grub pa'i lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gtsug tor nas brtsams te lus thams cad la reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ <rgyal ba rigs drug gi sa bon > kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa te <sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi mnga' bdag > badzra kā ya/ ma ma kā ya wāka tsitta <rdo rje'i skus bdag gi lus ngag sems >

dzñā na badzraṃ badzra kā ya swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru <ye shes rdo rje rdo rje'i sku'i rang bzhin du mdzod mdzod/> swāhā/ oṃ <de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sku'i rang bzhin can gyi > sarba ta thā ga ta badzra kā ya swa bhā wa <bdag nyid nga'o//> ātma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa yan lag drug 'god pa ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ oṃ hṛ da yā ya na maḥ dpral bar reg nas/ oṃ hrūṃ si ra se swāhā/ gtsug tor du reg nas/ oṃ shi khā yai bau ṣaṭa/ yan lag rnams la reg ste/ oṃ hrīṃ ka ba tsa ya hūṃ/ mig gnyis la reg ste/ oṃ hrāṃ nai tā ya wa ṣaṭa/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub phyogs bcur brdabs la/ oṃ hrāḥ.ast+rā ya phaṭa/ nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta <de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi > hṛ da ya <snying ga > si raḥ <mgo bo > shi khā <gtsug tor > ka wa tsa <go cha > nai tra <spyan > ast+ra <mtshon cha > badzra ṣaṭa aṃ ga <rdo rje yan lag drug > swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ <rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//> lnga pa bdud tshogs gzhom pa la sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ oṃ <rdo rje zla ba chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin chos thams cad rnam par sbyongs/> badzra tsant+ra sarba dharma su bi shuddha swa bhā wa sarba dharmān bi sho dha ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥ <rdo rje nyi ma chos thams cad rab tu rgyas par byed pa chos thams cad rab tu rgyas par mdzod/> badzra sūrya sarba dharma pra bo dha ka sarba dharman pra bo dha ya swāhā/ oṃ hūṃ <rdo rje me chos thams cad rab tu 'bar bar byed pa chos thams cad rab tu 'bar bar mdzod/> badzra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmān pra dī pa ya swāhā/ oṃ hoḥ <chos thams cad rdo rje bdud rtsir byed pa chos thams cad rdo rje bdud rtsir mdzod mdzod/> sarba dharma badzra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmān badzra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ <rdo rje gsum gyi sa bon no//> yul gyi bdag po/ sa pa ri wā rā ya/ <'khor dang bcas pa la > i daṃ ba liṃ/ <'di gtor ma > gandhaṃ/ <dri chab > puṣpaṃ/ <me tog > dhū paṃ/ <bdug spos > pra dī paṃ/ <sgron me > akṣa taṃ/ < mnyams 'bras bu > da dā ma he/ <bdag gis sbyin gyis > sa pa ri wā raḥ <'khor dang bcas pa > shā+-i ghraṃ/ < myur du > ā gatstsha tu/ <'byon par mdzod/> dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ <dgug gzhugs bcing mnyes byed pa'i sa bon no//> i daṃ ba liṃ/ <'di gtor ma > gṛnha tu/ <bzung bar mdzod > khā da tu/ <gsol bar mdzod > pi wa tu/ <btung ba mdzod > sa pa ri wā ra kaḥ <'khor bcas rnams kyis > sarba satwā nāṃ/ <sems can rnams la > shantiṃ/ <zhi ba > puṣtiṃ/ <rgyas pa > rakṣa <bsrung ba > ā wa ra ṇa/ <bskyab pa > guptiṃ/ <sba ba > ka ro tu/ < mdzad du gsol/ > i daṃ sthā naṃ/ <'di gnas > tyakt+wā/ < dor nas > bā hya maṇḍal <phyi rol dkyil 'khor gyi > bhū myāṃ <sa gzhi la > tiṣṭha tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ <gnas par mdzod/> badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ <rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/> khyi'i phyag rgya bcas la/ <rdo rje gsum gyi sa bon/> oṃ āḥhūṃ/ grong gi bdag po/ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha/ <byon byon > shī ghraṃ/ <myur du > i daṃ/ <'di > ba liṃ/ <gtor ma > gṛhna gṛhna/ <bzung zhing bzung nas > bhukt+wā/ <gsol zhing > pī twā <'thungs te > triptiṃ <tshim par > kri twā <byas nas > sarba <thams cad > satwā nāṃ/ <sems can rnams la > shāntiṃ/ <zhi ba'i > tsittaṃ/ <sems su > kri twā/ <byas nas > a pa ra sthā naṃ/ <gzhan gyi gnas su > gatstsha gatstsha <song song > swāhā/ gnyis pa dngos ni/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥ dmar po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang*/

snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūṃ nag po las rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa dang*/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥser po las rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa dang*/ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haṃ ljang khu las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa dang*/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la kṣaḥsngon po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams su gyur/ de bzhin du/ g.yon gyi phrag pa dang mthe'u chung la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su nga ngi ngu ngaṃ*/ gha ghi ghṛ ghu ghl̥ ghaṃ/ ga gi g-ir gu gl̥ gaṃ kha khi khu khl̥ khaṃ/ ka ki ku kl̥ kaṃ rnams dang*/ g.yas pa'i phrag pa dang mthe bong la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ /kkāḥ kkī kkā/ khkhāḥ khkhū khkhī khkhā/ ggāḥ ggū ggī ggā/ ghghāḥ ghghū ghghī ghghā/ rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa dang*/ rtse mo bdun pa rnams su gyur/ de bzhin du sbyar te g.yon gyi gru mo dang mthe'u chung la sogs pa'i dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ nya dzha dza tsha tsa rnams dang*/ g.yas kyi gru mo dang mthe bong la sogs pa'i dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ tsā tshā dzā dzhā nyā rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa dang rtse mo bdun pa rnams su gyur/ g.yon gyi 'khrig ma dang mthe'u chung la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa rnams dang*/ g.yas kyi 'khrig ma dang mthe bong la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su/ ṭā ṭhā ḍā ḍhā ṇā rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa dang rtse mo bdun pa rnams su gyur/ rkang pa g.yon gyi dpyi dang mthe'u chung la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ ma bha ba pha pa rnams dang*/ rkang pa g.yas kyi dpyi dang mthe bong la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su pā phā bā bhā mā rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa dang rtse mo bdun pa rnams su gyur/

g.yon gyi pus mo dang mthe'u chung la sogs pa'i dbus kyi tshigs rnams su na dha da tha ta rnams dang*/ g.yas kyi pus mo dang mthe bong la sogs pa'i dbus kyi tshigs rnams su tā thā dā dhā nā rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa dang rtse mo bdun pa rnams su gyur/ g.yon gyi long bu dang mthe'u chung la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su/ ྈྐ sha ṣa ྉྤ sa rnams dang*/ g.yas kyi long bu dang mthe bong la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su sā ṣā shā rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa dang rtse mo bdun pa rnams su gyur/ g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag la a ā ljang khu/ sna dag la e ai nag po/ mig dag la ar ār dmar po/ lce dang lce'u chung dag la o au dkar po/ rdo rje dang gsang bdag la al āl ser po/ yid dang khu ba'i rtsa dag la aṃ āḥsngon po rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse mo gsum pa rnams dang*/ gtsug tor dang mgo bor ha hā ljang khu/ lce dang rkan dag la ya yā nag po/ g.yon dang g.yas kyi lag mthil dag la ra rā dmar po/ rkang mthil dag la wa wā dkar po/ bshang lam gyi g.yon dang g.yas su la lā ser po rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa rnams su gyur/ de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur nas de nyid las 'phros pa'i rdo rje'i me dpung steng dang 'og tu ljang khu dang sngon po/ shar dang mer nag po/ lho dang bden bral du dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po/ nub dang rlung du ser po 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnams kyis sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa'i bdud kyi tshogs phyogs bcu na gnas pa mtha' dag nges par bsregs nas bde ba chen po la bkod par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ hrāḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥ ra ra ra ra/ badzra a na la/

<rdo rje me > sarba ā pa ra ṇa dharmā pra la ya swa bhā wa/ <sgrib pa'i chos thams cad nyams pa rang bzhin > sarba mā ra kā yi ka <thams cad bdud kyi ris dang > bighnān bi nā ya ka ā dī nāṃ/ <bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa3gt; da sha dika ga tā nāṃ/ <phyogs bcur gnas pa rnams kyi > kā ya <lus dang > wāka <ngag dang > tsitta ni/ <sems rnams > da ha da ha/ <sregs sregs > pa tsa pa tsa/ <tshos tshos > bhasmī ku ru ku ru <thal bar mdzod mdzod/> huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum sogs drag tu 'dod no/ /drug pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa ni/ haṃ las byung ba'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum gyi steng du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa bkra shis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa padmas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhi'i rnam pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de thams cad kyi steng dang 'og tu hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje kha sbyar bas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ hāṃ yāṃ rāṃ wāṃ lāṃ <'byung ba lnga'i sa bon > badzra ā kā sha bā yu te dza <rdo rje nam mkha' rlung me > u da ka <chu > pṛ thi bī/ <sa > badzra swa bhā wa/ <rdo rje rang bzhin > pañtsa dhā ta bo/ <khams lnga > badzra maṇḍa lā ni ku ru ku ru <rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rnams mdzod mdzod/> swāhā/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las/ rdo rje'i rwa ba rnams dang*/ rdo rje'i khang pa brtsegs pa la sogs pa yongs su grub par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ raḥ <rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon/> badzra tsand+ra sūrya rā hu kā la agna yaḥ <rdo rje zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dus me rnams > kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā na badzra prā kā rān ku ru ku ru

<sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje rwa ba rnams mdzod mdzod/> swāhā/ sa dang nam mkha' 'byar bar snang ba'i mtshams su rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi rwa ba gsum dang*/ yul 'khor bsrung ba'i don du yul 'khor gyi mtshams su rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi rwa ba lnga ste/ thams cad kyang steng dang 'og dang phyogs mtshams kun tu zlum po'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su rwa ba lnga'i khyon dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ rwa ba rnams kyi 'og tu mdung dang*/ steng du mda'i dra ba rnon po rnams su gyur/ oṃ hūṃ <rdo rje'i sa bon > bi shwa kā ya badzra badzra kū ṭā gā raṃ ku ru ku ru <sna tshogs sku rdo rje rdo rje'i khang pa brtsegs par mdzod mdzod/> swāhā/ rwa ba'i dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i khang pa gsum brtsegs pa khru nyis brgya pa/ dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ <padma'i sa bon > paṃ bi shwa badzra padmaṃ ku ru ku ru < sna tshogs rdo rje padma'i gdan mdzod mdzod/ > swāhā/ khang pa brtsegs pa bar ma'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i rtsibs brgyad khang brtsegs bar ma'i nang dang*/ steng 'og gi rtsibs gnyis steng 'og gi khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang du son zhing*/ dbus kyi lte ba'i nang du khru bcu gnyis pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /oṃ raḥ <nyi ma'i sa bon > badzra sūrya badzra sūrya ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru <rdo rje nyi ma rdo rje nyi ma'i gdan rnams mdzod mdzod/> swāhā/ padma'i lte ba khru bzhi pa'i steng du de dang mnyam pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du hūṃ las bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sku mdog nag po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing*/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag gi padma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te phyag nyi shu rtsa drug dang ldan pa/

zhabs g.yas dmar po brkyang zhing*/ g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas bdud dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ yi dwags kyi gdan la rnam par gnas pa/ g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa dmar po dang*/ dkar po dang*/ nag po'i mdog can/ mdun zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ zhal thams cad mche ba gtsigs pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba can/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu/ phyag gi mthil nas brtsams te/ tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o/ /sku la rdo rje'am rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga'am drug dang ldan pa/ dbu la rdo rje'i dar dpyangs kyi steng du rdo rje'i zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rked par stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ spyi bor thod pa lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ haṃ haḥ bā ma dakṣi ṇa karṇa yor badzra kunḍa le huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag la rdo rje'i rna rgyan du mdzod mdzod/> oṃ aṃ aḥ ka ṭyāṃ kanṭhe badzra me kha lā badzra kanṭhi ke huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <rked pa dang mgrin pa la rdo rje'i 'og pag dang rdo rje'i mgul rgyan du mdzod mdzod/> oṃ a āḥ bā ma dakṣi ṇa ka ra yor badzra ru tsa kau huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lag pa dag la rdo'i lag gdub tu mdzod mdzod/> oṃ ha hā/ bā ma dakṣi ṇa pā da yor badzra nū pu re huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i rkang pa dag la rdo rje'i rkang gdub tu mdzod mdzod/>

oṃ haṃ baṃ/ pañtsa ā kā ra mahā shū n+ya swa bhā wa <stong pa chen po rnam pa lnga'i rang bzhin > badzra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si <rdo rje spyi bo la nor bu spyi bo dang > sarba aṃ ge bhasmi huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <yan lag thams cad la thal ba mdzod mdzod/> oṃ aṃ/ ārdha nā rī shwa ra < phyed pa ma mo'i dbang phyug > badzra ardha tsand+ra badzra paṭṭa ūrdhe huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <rdo rje phyed pa'i zla ba rdo rje'i dar dpyangs kyi steng du mdzod mdzod/ yang na rus pa'i rgyan drug go/> oṃ a āḥ.aṃ/ sarba swa ra e ka tri <dbyangs thams cad gcig pa > swa ra swa bhā wa badzra yadzño pa bī ta skandhe huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <dbyangs gsum gyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i mchod phyir thogs phrag par mdzod mdzod/ phyag rgya drug dgod pa'o//> oṃ kṣaḥ dur dānta a bhi mā na kṣa yaṃ ka ra <gdul dka' ba mngon pa'i nga rgyal zad par byas pa > byāghra tsarma ka ṭau huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <stag gi pags pa rked par mdzod mdzod/> oṃ haṃ kṣaḥ triiṃ shata <sum cu > swa ra <dbyangs > sapta ti <bdun cu > hra swa <thung ngu > dīrgha < ring po > byañdza na swa bhā wa < gsal byed kyi rang bzhin > dai tya ku la sha ta si ro bh-ii ra muṇḍa mā le skandha a wa laṃ bi ni skandhai huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <lha min rigs brgya'i mgo bo rnams kyi mgo phreng phrag par 'phyang ba phrag pas mdzod mdzod/> oṃ ha hi hu hl̥/ pañtsa skandha bi shud dha swa bhā ba shi ra si <phung po lnga rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin spyi bor > ka pā la mā le huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <thod pa'i phreng ba mdzod mdzod/> g.yas kyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ ral gri /rtse gsum/ gri gug mda'/ lcags kyu/ ḍā ma ru/ tho ba/ 'khor lo/ mdung*/ dbyug pa/ dgra st+wa rnams so/ /g.yon gyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/ rdo rje'i dril bu/ phub/ kha ṭwāṃ ga thod pa/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che/ padma/

dung*/ me long*/ lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa rnams so/ /phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar bsnol zhing*/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa nag po dang*/ g.yon pa ser pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas bzung te gyon zhing*/ bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ < g.yas kyi phyag mtshan bcu gnyis kyi sa bon > kro dha badzra huṃ phaṭa/ < khro bo'i rdo rjer mdzod/ > oṃ badzra khaḍa ga huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i ral grir mdzod/> oṃ badzra tri shū la huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i rtse gsum du mdzod/> oṃ badzra karta ri huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i gri gug tu mdzod/> oṃ badzra pā ṇa huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i mda' ru mdzod/> oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i lcags kyur mdzod/> oṃ badzra ḍa ma ru ka huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i cang te'ur mdzod/> oṃ badzra mud ka ra huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i tho bar mdzod/> oṃ badzra tsakra huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i 'khor lor mdzod/> oṃ badzra kun ta huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i mdung du mdzod/> oṃ badzra daṇa ḍa huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i dbyug par mdzod/> oṃ badzra par shu huṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i dgra st+war mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ <sa bon > badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i dril bur mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra khe ṭa ka hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i phub tu mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra kha ṭwaṃ ga hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i kha ṭwāṃ gar mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra ka pā la hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i thod par mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra tsā pa hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i gzhu ru mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra pā sha hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i zhags par mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra ratna hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje rin po cher mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra padma hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i padmar mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra shaṃ kha hoḥphraiṃ phaṭa/

<rdo rje'i dung du mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra ā dar sha hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje'i me long du mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ badzra shriṃ kha le hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rdo rje lcags sgrog tu mdzod/> oṃ hwāṃ tsa tur be da mu kha swa bhā wa brahma shi raṃ hoḥphreṃ phaṭa/ <rigs bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi gdong can tshangs pa'i mgo bor mdzod/> oṃ kṣa kṣā kṣi kṣī kṣu kshū kṣl̥ kṣl̥̄ kṣaṃ kṣaḥ ha hā hi hī hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥ sarba bighna bi dā ri ta ga dza tsar ma pa ḍa ar tra rakta shra wa ta huṃ phreṃ/ <bgegs thams cad rnam par bcom pa'i glang po che bsad pa'i ko ba rlon pa khrag 'dzag par mdzod/> klu'i dbang po rgyal ba ral pa'i cod pan la bcings shing*/ rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings pas gnas pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang padma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa/ 'jog po dang padma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa'o/ /oṃ huṃ badzra dza ya nā ga ind+ra badzra dza ṭā mu ku ṭa ban dhe tiṣṭha tiṣṭha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <rdo rje rgyal ba klu'i dbang po rdo rje ral pa'i cod can la bcings pa gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/> oṃ kṣūṃ badzra bi dza ya nā ga ind+ra badzra paṭṭa ban dhe tiṣṭha tiṣṭha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <rdo rje rnam rgyal ba klu'i dbang po rdo rje dar dpyangs la 'chings pa gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/> oṃ hyaṃ hyāṃ badzra ka ra ko ṭa ka badzra padmau bā ma dakṣi ṇa kun ḍa la yoḥtiṣṭha tiṣṭha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <rdo rje stobs kyi rgyu dang rdo rje padma dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna rgyan dag la gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/> oṃ badzra bā su ki shaṃ kha pā lau bā ma dakṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yoḥtiṣṭha tiṣṭha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <rdo rje nor rgyas dang dung skyong dag g.yon dang g.yas gyi lag gdub dag la gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/>

oṃ hwaṃ hwāṃ badzra a nan ta ku li kau me kha lā kaṇa ṭhi ka yoḥtiṣṭha tiṣṭha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <rdo rje mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dag ske rags dang mgul rgyan dag la gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/> oṃ hlaṃ hlāṃ badzra takṣa ka mahā padmau bā ma dakṣi ṇa pā da nū pu ra yoḥtiṣṭha tiṣṭha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <rdo rje 'jog po dang padma chen po dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi rkang gdub dag la gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/> de ltar bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing*/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ huṃ <khro bo'i sa bon > kro dhā ind+ro3haṃ <khro bo'i dbang po nga*/> kro dhā nāṃ ādzñā dā ya ka <khro bo rnams la bka' bsgo pa po nga yin no//> swāhā/ de nas khang pa brtsegs pa'i steng dang 'og dang khang brtsegs bar ma'i rwa ba la nye bar phyogs dang phyogs bral gyi khro bo bcu'i gnas/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyi nang du raḥyig yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ ha hā las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dang gnod mdzes rgyal po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu dang sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra st+wa/ g.yon pa gsum gyis/ rdo rje'i dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa dag zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ steng du khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang gi rtsibs kyi nang dang*/ 'og dang rdo rje sa gzhi la rtsibs kyi nang du £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la £© gnas pa'o/ /yi yī las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag yongs su gyur pa las/

bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug nas spros te/ shar dang me'i rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab mthar byed dang ṭakki zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/ wu wū las 'byung ba'i padma dkar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ padma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung*/ rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i padma dkar po/ me long*/ bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa dag lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang*/ ll̥ ll̥̄ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung*/ rdo rje'i lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dag bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung gi rtsibs su gnas pa ste/ thams cad kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyang gis gnas shing*/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/
khro bo'i dbang po lta bu ste/ khang brtsegs kyi nang bsrung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ nga ngā las byung ba'i zad par stong pa ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis zhal gyi gtso bo'i du nam g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i phyi rol kyi steng mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gnod mdzes kyi 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /nyi nyī las byung ba'i zad par rlung nag po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/ shar dang mer gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i zad par me dmar po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang*/ mu mū las byung ba'i zad par chu dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang*/ nl̥ nl̥̄ las byung ba'i zad par sa ser po gnyis bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas gnas pa/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i phyi rol bsrung zhing skyong ba ste/ zad par dang khro bo nam mkha' dang ye shes yang dag par sbyor bas sems kyi khams bsrung bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ gha ghā las byung ba'i tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug gnyis zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ rwa ba gsum pa'i nang gi tshad kyi steng dang 'og tu gnas par gyur/ dzhi dzhī las byung ba'i bden bral dang rlung lha gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug nas spros te/ shar dang mer gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i gshin rje dang me lha gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang*/ bhu bhū las byung ba'i rgya mtsho dang bde byed gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang*/

las byung ba'i dbang po dang gnod sbyin gnyis bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/ de dag kyang*/ ngang pa la gnas tshangs pa ljang khu rig byed zhal/ /phyag bzhi khab dang bgrang 'phreng padma spyi blugs 'dzin/ /mkha' lding la gnas khyab 'jug sngon po rgya mtsho'i phyag / 'khor lo dbyug tho padma skye lnga'i dung gi mtshan/ /yi dwags la gnas bden bral mig sman lta bu'i mdog /phyag bzhi ral gri gri gug phub dang thod pas brgyan/ / ri dwags la gnas rlung lha nag po phyag bzhi yis/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i me tog nor bu utpal 'dzin/ /ma he la gnas gshin rje shin tu dmar ba'i mdang*/ /phyag bzhi dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrog zhags pas brgyan/ lug la nyer gnas me lha dmar po rig byed phyag /shakti dbyug pa chu skyes spyi blugs mtshan mas spras/ /chu srin la gnas rgya mtsho dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ /zhags pa rin chen sbrul zhags zla ba chu shel 'dzin/ /khyu mchog la gnas bde byed dkar po dus kyi phyag /rtse gsum mda' dang sbrul ldan kha ṭwāṃ gzhu yis mtshan/ /glang chen la gnas dbang po gser mdog rig byed phyag /rdo rje me mda' rdo rje dril bu gzhu yis mtshan/ /'khor los drangs pa'i khang brtsegs la gnas gnod sbyin ser/ /phyag bzhi nor bu be con ne'u le padma'o/ /de ltar phyogs skyong bcu ni rwa ba gsum pa'i nang bsrung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'o/ / slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ ga gā las byung ba'i sgra gcan dang dus me ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ rwa ba gsum pa'i phyi rol kyi steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ / dzi dzī las byung ba'i nyi ma dang zla ba nag po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/

shar dang mer gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i gza' lhag dang bkra shis dmar po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang*/ bu bū las byung ba'i pa sangs dang phur bu dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i mjug ring dang spen pa ser po gnyis bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/ de dag kyang*/ sgra gcan dus me dag ni lag gnyis nyi zla 'dzin/ /rta bdun nyi dkyil bsil zer zla ba phyed pa ste/ /gza' lhag mda' gzhu mig dmar chu gri mi mgo bsnams/ /dkar po bla ma bgrang 'phreng spyi blugs mjug ring ni/ /ral gri sbrul zhags spen pa dbyug to khu tshur brten/ /thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ rwa ba gsum pa'i phyi rol bsrung zhing skyong ba ste/ gza' dang phyogs skyong me dang rlung yang dag par sbyor bas ngag gi khams bsrung bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du/ brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ kha khā las byung ba'i rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis/ zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ rwa ba lnga pa'i nang gi steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /tshi tshī las byung ba'i stobs kyi rgyu dang padma nag po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/ shar dang mer gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang*/ phu phū las byung ba'i mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i 'jog po dang padma chen po ser po gnyis bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/

nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/ thams cad rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing*/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ rwa ba lnga pa'i nang bsrung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ ka kā las byung ba'i ro langs dang grul bum ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis/ zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ rwa ba lnga pa'i phyi rol kyi steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /tsi tsī las byung ba'i mi 'am ci khyi'i gdong pa can dang*/ skyes bu 'am ci bya rog gi gdong pa can nag po gnyis/ g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/ shar dang mer gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i dri za phag gi gdong pa can dang*/ 'byung po bya rgod kyi gdong pa can dmar po gnyis/ g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang*/ pu pū las byung ba'i srin po stag gi gdong pa can dang*/ yi dwags 'ug pa'i gdong pa can dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i brjed byed lce spyang gi gdong pa can dang*/ nam mkha' lding ser po gnyis bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/ thams cad rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la zlum po'i stabs kyi gnas shing*/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba mgul du 'phyang ba/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ rwa ba lnga pa'i phyi rol bsrung zhing skyong ba ste/

klu dang 'byung po chu dang sa yang dag par sbyor bas lus kyi khams bsrung bar mdzad pa'o/ / nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ <de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//> sarba ta thā ga tā rakṣā tsakra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ khro bo rnams la bka' bsgo ba ni/ oṃ haṃ <rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po gtsug tor chen po steng gi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza mahā uṣṇi ṣa ur dha di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yaṃ < rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po shin tu stobs thams cad bgegs mthar byed pa shar phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza a ti bā la sarba bighna anta ka pūrba di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ raṃ <rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po rmugs byed gdug pa'i shes rab mthar byed pa lho'i phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza dzambha ka duṣta pradzñā anta ka dakṣī ṇa di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ waṃ <rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po nga rgyal rnam par chags pa'i padma mthar byed pa byang phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza mā na ka bi rā ga padma an ta ka utta ra di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ laṃ <rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po rengs byed gshin rje mthar byed pa nub phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza stambha ka ya ma anta ka paṣtsi ma di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ lāḥ <rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po stobs po chen po rlung gi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza mahā ba la bā ya byāṃ di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ wāḥ <rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po mi g.yo ba dbang ldan gyi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza a tsa la ī sha na di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ rāḥ

<rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po 'dod pa bden bral gyi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza ṭakki nai ṛ tyāṃ di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yāḥ <rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po dbyug sngon can me'i phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza nī la daṇa ḍā agne yyāṃ di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ hāḥ <rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po gnod mdzes 'og gi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/> badzra kro dha rā dza sumbha a dho di shi rakṣāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de dag gis kyang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing rdo rje zhags pas bcings pa rnams kyi steng du/ rdo rje phur bu rno zhing rab tu 'bar ba stod khro bo'i gzugs can rnams kyis btab par 'gyur/ phur bu bsgril ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra kī la/ <rdo rje'i phur buu > kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa ti ṣaḍa mu kha/ <sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi mnga' bdag zhal drug pa > ṣaḍa bhu dza/ <phyag drug pa > ṣaḍa tsa ra ṇa/ <zhabs drug pa > sarba bighna bi nā ya ka ā di duṣtā nāṃ/ <thams cad pa gegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa gdug pa rnams kyi > kā ya wāka tsitta dzñā nā ni/ <lus ngag sems ye shes rnams la > kī' la ya kī la ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ <phur bus thobs phur bus thobs/> phur bu 'debs pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ll̥ḥ badzra mud ga ra mā ra ā dī nāṃ/ <rdo rje tho bas bdud la sogs pa rnams kyi > si ra si <mgo bo > kanṭhe <mgrin pa > hri da ye <snying ga > nā bhau <lte ba > gu hye/ ante badzra kī la kān/ <gsang ba'i mthar thug pa rdo rje phur bu > ā ko ṭa ya/ <rdungs > ā ko ṭa ya/ <rdungs/> kṣaṃ kṣāṃ kṣiṃ kṣīṃ kṣuṃ kṣūṃ kṣl̥ṃ kṣl̥̄ṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur zhing*/

lhag ma rnams kyang ring du bros par gyur/ skabs 'dir long skabs yod cing spro na/ rkang pa bcu drug pa dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bzlas pa yang byed par gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'on kyang de dag dngos gzhi'i bzlas par byed pa gtso che bas/ phyag len la skabs 'dir mi mdzad do/ /'dir gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ gong du bshad pa'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ spel/ sbar/ bdud rtsir byas nas/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas spyan drang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ badzra bhai ra wa bhī ka rā ya/ sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ <'khor dang bcas pa rnams la > rdo rje'i phyag rgyas 'bul ba ni/ i daṃ/ <'di > ba liṃ/ <gtor ma > gandhaṃ/ <dri > puṣpaṃ/ <me tog > nghū paṃ/ <bdug spos > dī paṃ/ <sgron me > akṣa taṃ/ <ma nyams pa > da dā ma he/ <bdag 'bul gyis > te tsa ā ga tya/ <de rnams kyang byon nas > sa pa ri wā raḥ <'khor dang bcas pa rnams > shī ghraṃ/ <myur duu > i daṃ/ <'di > ba liṃ/ <gtor ma > gṛhnantu/ <bzung bar mdzod > khā dantu/ <gsol bar mdzod > pi bantu/ <btung bar mdzod/> dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ <de ni dgug gzhug bcing mnyes sa bon > saṃ trib tāḥ <yang dag par mnyes pa rnams > sarba satwa nāṃ/ <sems can thams cad kyi > shantiṃ/ <zhi ba > puṣtiṃ/ <rgyas pa > rakṣa/ <bsrung ba > ā wa ra ṇa/ <bskyab pa > guptaṃ/ <sba ba > kurbantu <mdzad du gsol/> huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra/ <rdo rje 'chang gi > ādzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ <bka' bzhin mdzod/> rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ <rdo rje'i bzhi'i sa bon > uṣṇi ṣa/ <gtsug tor > sum bha ni sum bha/ <gnod mdzes nges par gnod mdzes > bighna anta ka < bgegs mthar byed > nī la dāṇḍa/ <dbyug pa sngon po > pradzñā anta ka <shes rab mthar byed > ṭakki rā dza/ <'dod pa'i rgyal po > padma anta ka <padma mthar byed > a tsa la/ <mi g.yo ba > ya ma anta ka <gshin rje mthar byed

> mahā ba le bhyaḥ <stobs po che rnams/> gri gug gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ ā ka shā/ <nam mkha' > ba yu <rlung > te dza <me > uu da ka <chuu > pri thi wī/ <sa > sā' dhi te bhyaḥ <grub pa rnams/> ral gri'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ prahma/ <tshangs pa > biṣṇu/ <khyab 'jug > nai ṛ tya/ <bden bral > bā yu/ <rlung > ya ma/ <gshin rje > agni/ <me > sa mu tra <rgya mtsho > ī shwa ra/ <dbang phyug > ind+ra/ <dbang po > yakṣe bhyaḥ <gnod sbyin rnams/> rin po che'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ rā hu/ <sgra gcan > kā la agni/ <dus me > tsand+ra/ <zla ba > sūrya/ <nyi ma > bu dha/ <gza' lag > maṅga la/ <bkra shis > shu kra/ <pa sangs > bṛ has pa ti/ <phur buu > ke du/ <mjug ring > sha ni bhyaḥ <spen pa rnams/> padma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ dza ya/ <rgyal ba > bi dza ya/ < rnam par rgyal ba > padma/

<padma > karko ṭa ka <stobs kyi rgyuu > ba su ki <nor rgyas > shaṃ kha pā la/ <dung skyong > ku li ka <rigs ldan > a nanta <mtha' yas > takṣa ka <'jog po > mahā padma bhyaḥ <padma chen po rnams/> 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ be tā ḍa/ <ro langs > bi kṛta mu kha <rnams par 'gyur ba'i zhal can te grul bum > shwā/ <khyi > kā ka <bya rog > sū ka ra/ <phag > gṛ dhra/ <bya rgod > byā ghra/ <stag3gt; u lū ka <'ug pa > dzambu ka <lce spyang > ga ru ḍa/ < mkha' lding > mu khe bhyaḥ <gdong can rnams/> zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ akṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te dza ā ga tya/ sa pā ri wā raḥ shī ghraṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛ hṇantu/ khā dantu/ pi bantu/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛptā/ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shān tiṃ/ puṣtiṃ/ rakṣa/ ā ba ra ṇa/ guptiṃ/ kurbantu huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ phyi mchod ni/ badzra bhai ra wa bhī ka rā ya/ <rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa > sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra dhu paṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra dī paṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra nai be tyaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra akṣa taṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra lā syaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra hā syaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra wa tyaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra nṛ tyāṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra gī taṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ nang mchod ni/ oṃ badzra bhai ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha ḍha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āḥhuṃ/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad/ /dpa' bo gdul dkar 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/sde drug bsrung ma drug cu 'khor bcas la/ /mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang*/ /bdug spos snang gsal ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi/ /de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la/ /gtor ma 'di dag len zhing gsol ba dang*/ btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yis/ /'gro la zhi rgyas bsrung skyob sba ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ / gshegs su gsol ba ni/ gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtsug tor du aṃ yig la zad par gyi 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gshegs su gsol/ dpral bar i yig la phyogs skyong gi 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ mgrin par ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ snying gar u yig la klu'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ lte bar l̥ yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ bdun pa tshogs zhing spyan drang ba ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar paṃ las byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar aṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las rdo rje nyi ma bzhin du 'od zer kha dog lnga rnams 'phros pas/ bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas/ nam mkha'i mthil du badzra sa mā dzaḥ 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje la zhugs par gyur/ brgyad pa mchod pa rnam pa bdun ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs dpal la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/

/pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ oṃ badzra gandhe gandha artsanaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra mā le mā la artstsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra nghū pe nghū pa artstsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra pra dī pe pra dī pa artstsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra a mṛ te nai we tya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra akṣa te akṣa ta pha la artstsha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra lā sya wast+ra a bha ra ṇa pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra hā sya ghanṭa ā darsha pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra bā dye bā dya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra nṛ tye nṛ tya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra gī te gī ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badzra kā me sarba buddha bo dhi satwā nāṃ kro dha ā dī nāṃ/ badzra su ra ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ srid 'gro nyams ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi lus 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ / dgu pa lam bsten pa ni/ byang chub mchog gi sems dang ni/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang*/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin spong ba'i/ /rtsa ba bsten bgyi tshogs gsum phyir/

/sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs dang ni/ /smon lam stobs dang ye shes kyi/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs par bgyi/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*/ /btang snyoms rnams la gnas bgyi zhing*/ /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /don spyod pa dang don mthun spyad/ /srog gcod ma byin gzhan gyi bud med dang*/ /rdzun dang tshig rtsub rnams dang phra ma dang*/ /'khyal bar 'gyur ba'i tshig dang brnab sems dang*/ /gnod sems lta ba ngan pa rnam par spang*/ /'gyod dang gnyid rmugs rgod dang the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga po yongs su spang bgyi zhing*/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal gyi/ /nyon mongs bzhi rnams bdag gis kun tu spang*/ /'dod dang srid pa ma rig lta ba yi/ /zag pa bzhi yang yongs su spang bgyi'o/ / bcu pa stong pa nyid la dmigs pa ni/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /khams gsum po rnam par dpyad na cir yang mi dmigs pa dang*/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi chu'i khams kyis me rnam par nyams shing*/ me med pas sa yang sra ba nyid dor nas/ lan tshwa bzhin du zhu bar gyur te chu la thim zhing*/ chu yang rlung gis skams par byas nas/ rlung gi tshogs rnams nam mkha' la mi snang bar gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'-i stong pa nyid do/ /oṃ <stong pa nyid kyi ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//> n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ <mtshan ma med pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//> a ni mitta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ <smon pa med pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//> a pra ṇi hi ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ <mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//>

bhi saṃ skā ra dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ sku rdzogs pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog thig le rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor/ bde ba rdzogs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang sgom pa dang*/ brten pa lha sgom pa gnyis las/ dang po la yang gnyis kyi/ dang po gzhal yas khang gsal gdab pa ni/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po/ dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'idakyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum pa bkra shis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa padmas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhi'i rnam pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de thams cad kyi steng dang 'og tu hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis dang ldan par gyur/ sa'i steng du maṃ las ri rab lhun po 'og gi rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug pa/ steng la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa'o/ /de'i steng du kṣaṃ las sna tshogs chu skyes dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ lte ba padma'i sum cha'i tshad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du haṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor padma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rnam par bcad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor mthon mthing nyi ma dang mnyam pa de rnams gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las/

zhes pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams snga ma bzhin du grub par gyur/ lhun po'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can gyi gzhi la bhrūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor rim pa gsum las/ phyi rol tu sku'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa dang*/ de'i nang gi phyed du gsung gi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa dang*/ de'i yang nang gi phyed du thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa ste/ sgo bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor so so la nang nas rim pa bzhin du ste/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la rin po che nag po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po'i rwa ba rim pa gsum dang*/ gsung dang sku'i dkyil 'khor la rin po che ljang khu dang*/ nag po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po dang*/ ser po'i rwa ba rim pa lnga lnga dang ldan pa ste/ sgo dang mnyam pa'i sgo khyud dang sgo 'gram dang sgo logs te/ glo 'bur gyi rnam pa grub pa'i sgo khang nyid do/ /rwa ba rnams kyi phyi rol tu stegs bu dkar po 'gram stegs kyi rnam pa can khor yug tu yongs su bskor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gsum char la mtshungs par rwa ba'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po kha bad kyi rnam pa can la rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa dang*/ de'i steng du thog phubs kyi gdung 'degs pa'i ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa dkar po/ me long dang*/ rnga yab dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i ba ku li dang*/ steng du mdzes par tshar du mngar ba'i kra ma shīrṣa dkar po'o/ /sgo khang rnams kyi steng du sgo las sum 'gyur gyi rta babs nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin brtsegs ma gsum dang*/

sgo logs kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu'i steng du btsugs pa'i ka ba ser po bzhi bzhis bteg pa rnams te/ brtsegs ma re re la'ang gdung dang*/ myos pa bsrung ba dang*/ ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ 'og gzhi kha dog sna tshogs pa shin tu mdzes pa'o/ /de la brtsegs ma dang po'i logs gnyis nas glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge dag dang*/ brtsegs ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i logs gnyis nas mchod pa'i lha mo dag gis gdung 'degs bzhin pa dang*/ steng du har mi mdzes pa bum pa'i tog dang bcas pa/ bum pa'i g.yas dang g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang snam bu rnams las dril bu dang*/ me long dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rnga yab la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas du ma nye bar dpyangs pa ste/ gzhal yas khang gi zur rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ sgo dang sgo khyud gyi mtshams kyi zur la rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi phyed du bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed pa dang*/ de'i nang gi phyed du oṃ yig las byung ba'i gtso bo'i padma rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang*/ de'i lte ba la ma yig las byung ba'i zla ba dang*/ ra yig las byung ba'i nyi ma dang*/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa ste/ gnam stong gi mthar nyi zla gnyis ka gzas 'dzin pa dang*/ rtsa gsum gcig tu gyur pa'i dag pa'o/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la bung ba'i mdog can gyi ka ba bcu drug ste/ shar du ral gri'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi dang*/ lhor rin po che'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi dang*/ byang du padma'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi dang*/ nub tu 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi'o/ /ka ba de rnams kyi nang gi thad sor yang gtso bo'i padma la gru bzhir bskor ba'i ka ba bcu gnyis te/

phyi nang gi ka ba de dag gis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung rim pa gnyis kyi nang ma sngon po dang phyi ma ljang khu'o/ /nang gi ka ba rdo rje'i gdung dang bcas pa'i steng du yang ka ba rnams kyis bteg pa'i gtso bo'i gnas kyi thog phub phyur bu'i rnam pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar mdzes pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum char la rwa ba rnams kyi nang du snying po'i sgo'i drug cha spangs par lha snam dkar po'o/ /gtso bo'i padma 'og gzhi sngon po dang*/ de nas mchod pa'i sa'i mthar thug pa'i 'og gzhi rdo rje'i sa dang steng gi thog rnams kyi mdog ni gtso bo'i zhal gyi dbye bas shar nag po/ lho dmar po/ byang dkar po/ nub ser po'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la padma dang bum pa bzang po la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung du ma nye bar 'khrigs pa dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu sa'i 'khor yug gi steng gi nam mkha' la dbang ldan nas zla ba nya gang ba 'char bzhin pa dang*/ bden bral du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub bzhin pa'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol tu chu dang me dang rlung gi khor yug rnams dang*/ de'i phyi rol tu nam mkha'i khor yug la dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba ste/ de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol phyogs kun nas rdo rje'i me lce ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba'o/ /thugs dang gsung gi rta babs kyi re'u mig gi gzhi kha dog sna tshogs pa la mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa dag gnas shing*/ sku'i rta 'bab kyi brtsegs ma 'og ma'i re'u mig dbus ma'i gnas la shar du chos kyi 'khor lo nag po/ g.yas dang g.yon du ri dwags dang ri dwags mo/ lhor bum pa bzang po dmar po/ g.yas dang g.yon du dung dang padma/ byang du rnga bo che dkar po/ g.yas dang g.yon du dbyug pa dang tho ba/ nub tu byang chub kyi shing ser po/

g.yas dang g.yon du mi'am ci dang mi'am ci mo dag gnas shing*/ re'u mig gi gnas gzhan rnams su mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa gnas pa'o/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma'i ka ba rnams kyi bar bar du oṃ yig las skyes pa'i padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lha'i gdan rnam pa brgyad de/ phyogs bzhi dkar po dang*/ mtshams bzhi dmar po'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du yang bdud rtsi'i bum pa brgyad kyi gnas so/ /thugs kyi lha snam la shar dang lho'i g.yas dang g.yon dang byang dang nub kyi g.yas rnams su oṃ yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ mtshams rnams dang*/ byang dang nub kyi g.yon dag tu oṃ yig las byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ shar dang byang gi sgor padma dkar po dang*/ lho dang nub kyi sgor padma dmar po'o/ /padma dmar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar lo'i phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nya bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa ma yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang*/ dkar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar gnam stong bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa ra yig las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis so/ /gsung gi lha snam la phyogs bzhir oṃ yig las byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ mtshams bzhir oṃ yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /sku'i lha snam la phyogs bzhi'i g.yas dang g.yon rnams su oṃ yig la byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma nyer brgyad pa brgyad dang*/ mtshams bzhir oṃ yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po 'dab ma nyer brgyad pa bzhi ste/ rim pa dang po la 'dab ma bzhi/ gnyis pa la 'dab ma brgyad/ gsum pa la 'dab ma bcu drug dang bcas pa'i lte ba la lha rnams kyi bzhon pa dang bcas pa'o/ /sku'i shar sgor phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta nag po/ lho sgor rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta dmar po/ byang sgor seng ge bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta dkar po/

nub sgor glang po che bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta ser po/ steng du nam mkha' lding mig gsum pa kha dog lnga pa bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta ljang khu/ 'og tu seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta sngon po'o/ /me dang rlung gi khor yug gi mtshams su dur khrod chen po mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa brgyad la/ phyogs bzhir rtsibs brgyad pa'i 'khor lo dmar po rnams dang*/ mtshams bzhir rtsibs brgyad pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rnams dang*/ steng dang 'og tu yang shing rta ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis so/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po kun nas dwangs shing sgrib pa med la/ phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal zhing*/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/

gnyis pa dag dran na ི/ ka ba rnams dang rdo rje phreng ba sa'i dkyil 'khor rtsig pa nyid ni rus pa rnams kyis mdzod/ /sha khrag chu dang bshang ba rnams kyis lha dang gshin rje nor sbyin gzhan du rdul tshon gdab pa ste/ /mkhris pa bad kan gyis ni nyi ma ri bong can yang de bzhin chu rgyus rnams kyis chu skyes rnams/ /rwa ba lnga yi re khā sa dang chu dang bsreg za rlung dang nam mkha' las skyes rnams kyis so/ /dus kyi rtsa yis gtso bo'i chu skyes g.yo ba me yi dkyil 'khor la sogs pags pa la sogs kyis/ /nyi ma'i sgo rnams bug pa rnams kyis nor bu'i rang bzhin bkod pa so yi 'phreng bas de bzhin nyid/ /g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas dur khrod brgyad du 'khor lo rnams ni sor mo rnams kyi sen mo yis/ /ba spu rnams kyis dkyil 'khor mthar ni phyogs dang phyogs bral dag tu gnas pa'i rdo rje me lce ste/ de ltar mchog gi yon tan rnam mang sku yi rdo rje nges par dkyil 'khor gyis ni rnam par gsungs/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun chos/ / thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rnams kyis ni/ /rdo rje'i thig ni bzhi po ste/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams kyis/ /gru bzhi mnyam pa de nyid de/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa yis/ /sgo ni bcu gnyis po rnams te/ /de bzhin sa ni bcu gnyis kyis/ /rta babs dag ni mdzes pa rnams/ / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams kyis/ /phyogs brgyad du ni dur khrod rnams/ / stong nyid bcu drug ka ba rnams/ khams rnams kyis kyang khang pa brtsegs/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis sgo khyud rnams// gzugs can yon tan brgyad rnams kyis/ / 'gram rnams dang ni logs rnams nyid/ /thugs gsung sku yi dbye bas so/ /tshul khrims la sogs phung po lngas/ /kha dog lnga ni rnam par dag /theg pa gsum gyis rwa ba gsum/ /dad pa'i dbang po sogs kyis lnga/

/dad sogs stobs rnams dag gis lnga/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor la'o/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la stegs bu ste/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa yis/ /rin chen snam bu rnam par bkra/ /ma 'dres chos ni bcwa brgyad kyis/ /do shal do shal phyed pa rnams// dbang rnams kyis kyang ba ku lī/ /dge bas kra ma shīrṣa 'o/ /stong nyid la sogs rnam thar gyis/ /dril bu'i sgras ni gang ba ste/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas rgyal mtshan gtams// spong bas me long rab tu 'bar/ / byang chub yan lag rnga yab g.yo/ /yan lag dgu yis 'phreng bas brgyan/ /bsdu ba bzhi po rnams kyis ni/ /zur du sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /bden bzhis rin po che rnams kyis/ /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams su spras// mngon shes lnga yis rtag tu ni/ /khor yug chen po lnga yis bskor/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen byang chub pas/ /rdo rje 'phreng bas legs par bskor/ /bde ba gcig pu'i khor yug gis/ /de bzhin ye shes rdo rje 'bar/ /thabs dang shes rab cha yis ni/ /zla ba nyi ma rtag tu shar/ / thugs gsung sku dang dag pa yis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bum pa che/ /rnga bo che dang byang chub shing*/ /de bzhin yid bzhin nor bu sogs/ /'di ni dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ /dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings nyid do/ / gnyis pa brten pa lha sgom pa la gnyis las/ dang po lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a i ṛ u l̥/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la aṃ zhes pa rnams g.yon bskor dang*/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ār ai ā/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā aḥ zhes pa rnams g.yas bskor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dang ldan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'og tu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/

lla lla ssa ṣṣa shsha tta dda nna/ ppa phpha mma/ ṭṭa ḍḍa ṇṇa/ tstsa tshtsha dzdza kka khkha gga ghgha zhes pa rnams g.yas bskor dang*/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na ngha da tha ta/ ྈྐ sha ṣa ྉྥ sa/ ha ya ra wa la/ ḍha ḍa ya wa la/ zhes pa rnams g.yon bskor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dang ldan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /zla ba'i dbus su hūṃ yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de rnams gcig tu gyur pa hi yig dang bcas pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de las lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa haṃ yig dang bcas pa ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga rnams 'gyed cing*/ bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i snying gar mnan pa'i zhabs gnyis pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag gi padma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa dmar po brkyangs pas 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis gyis me tog gi mda' lnga dang*/ lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ g.yon pa dkar po bskums pas drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/ mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ bdud kyi dga' ma dang*/ drag po'i u ma dag ni dman pa'i gdong gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin par byed cing g.yo ba med par gnas pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa nyi ma dang zla ba dang bung ba'i mdog can/ mdun zhal nag po mche ba phyed gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/

rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ste/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ spyi gtsug tu rdo rje nor bu dang*/ rdo rje rna rgyan dang*/ rdo rje mgul rgyan dang*/ rdo rje gdub bu dang*/ rdo rje ska rags dang*/ rdo rje rkang gdub dang*/ rdo rje dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' dang ldan pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag dar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de dag re re la yang sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu'o/ /de rnams re re la yang phyag gi mthil nas brtsams te/ tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po rnams nag po/ gnyis pa rnams dmar po/ gsum pa rnams dkar po'o/ /de lta bu'i phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gug dmar po bzhis/ mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma ru/ tho ba/ dkar po bzhis/ 'khor lo/ mdung*/ dbyug pa/ dgra st+wa rnams 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje'i dril bu/ phub/ kha ṭwāṃ ga kha phye ba/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhis/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che/ padma dkar po/ dkar po bzhis/ dung*/ me long*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa padmas spras pa 'dzin zhing*/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa ste/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don dam pa'i bde ba'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo/ zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad ma/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nub zhal gtso bor bzhag pa lta bur mdun zhal ser mo/

g.yas zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma ru/ bgrang 'phreng rnams 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa/ zhags pa/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i padma dkar po/ rin po che rnams 'dzin pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril shing*/ des kyang snyoms par zhugs pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan brgyad ni 'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa ste/ shar dang nub tu a ā/ byang dang lhor aṃ aḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rim pa bzhin du bdug spos kyi snod dang*/ dri'i dung dang*/ lha bshos dang*/ mar me phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang*/ me dang rlung du ha hā/ dbang ldan dang bden bral du haṃ haḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rnga yab phyogs kyi mdog can rnams so/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar du nag mo 'bar ma/ nag dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis bdug spos dang*/ tsandan dang*/ gur gum dang*/ gla rtsir bcas pa'i ga pur rnams kyi snod dang*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang*/ padma dang*/ yongs 'du'i me tog dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lhor dmar mo 'bar ma/ dmar ser dkar nag pa'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis mar me dang*/ do shal dang*/ cod pan dang*/ gdub bu/ g.yon pa rnams kyis gos dang*/ ska rags dang*/ rin po che'i rna rgyan dang*/ rkang gdub 'dzin pa/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma/ dkar nag dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'o ma dang*/ chu dang*/ sman bzang po dang*/ chang rnams kyi snod dang*/

g.yon pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi dang*/ grub pa'i bcud len dang*/ bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu dang*/ 'bras chan rnams kyi snod 'dzin pa/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma/ ser dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis dung dang*/ gling bu dang*/ nor bu dang*/ ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa rnams kyis pi wang dang*/ rnga dang*/ 'khar rnga dang*/ zangs dung rnams 'dzin pa/ mer du ba ma nag mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab nag po brgyad bsnams pa/ bden bral du smig rgyu ma dmar mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab dmar po brgyad bsnams pa/ dbang ldan du me khyer ma dkar mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab dkar po brgyad bsnams pa/ rlung du mar me ma ser mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab ser po brgyad bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gyi mdog ni g.yas bskor kyi rim pa ste/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad/ spyan bcu gnyis ma/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can no/ /'di dag gi rgyab tu yang dbang ldan du oṃ las byung ba'i chos kyi dung dkar po/ bden bral du āḥlas byung ba'i chos kyi gaṇḍī dmar po/ mer hūṃ las byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu nag po/ rlung du hoḥlas byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing ser po rnams su gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams spro ba ni/ 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yum la snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rnam par dag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched las dbang yul dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo yab yum thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/

slar yang rang nyid las 'phros te sna tshogs yum la zhugs par gyur/ de las kyang log nas slar rang nyid la zhugs te/ zla ba byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra st+wā/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por bzhugs par gyur/ i yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ka dkar po 'dzin pa la/ spyan ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ṛ yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa la/ mā ma kī dkar mos 'khyud pa/ lhor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ u yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ snang ba mtha' yas zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/

phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung*/ rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i padma dkar po/ me long*/ bgreng 'phreng 'dzin pa la/ gos dkar mo dmar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ l̥ yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa la/ sgrol ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub tu pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ lnga char yang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ padma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing*/ thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /ī yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol ma nag mo don yod grub pa lta bu la/ rnam par snang mdzad ser pos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ṝ yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ gos dkar mo dmar mo rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu la/ snang ba mthar yas dkar pos 'khyud pa/ bden bral du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ū yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ mā ma kī dkar mo snang ba mtha' yas lta bu la/ rin chen 'byung ldan dmar pos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ l̥̄ yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo'i ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo rnam snang lta bu la/ don yod grub pa nag pos 'khyud pa/ rlung mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang padma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la padma'i gdan gyis gnas shing*/ shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de dag gi g.yon dang g.yas su yang hi hī

hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po padma la gnas shing padma'i kha brgyan pa brgyad de/ shar du rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ lhor khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ byang du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ nub tu bshang ba 'gags pa'i gnyis so/ /haṃ haḥlas byung ba'i steng du khu ba 'gags pa'i bum pa dang*/ 'og tu rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa rnams su gyur/ yaṃ yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ bgegs mthar byed nag po don yod grub pa lta bu la/ lāḥyig las byung ba'i rengs byed ma ser mo gshin rje mthar byed lta bus 'khyud pa/ shar sgor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ raṃ yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab mthar byed dmar po rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu la/ wāḥyig las byung ba'i khengs byed ma dkar mo padma mthar byed lta bus 'khyud pa/ lho sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ waṃ yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ padma mthar byed dkar po snang ba mtha' yas lta bu la/ rāḥyig las byung ba'i rmugs byed ma dmar mo shes rab mthar byed lta bus 'khyud pa/ byang sgor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ laṃ yig las byung ba'i tho ba ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje mthar byed ser po rnam par snang mdzad lta bu la/ yāḥyig las byung ba'i shin tu brtson 'grus ma nag mo bgegs mthar byed lta bus 'khyud pa/ nub sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ khro bo khro mo brgyad po de rnams zhal re re la spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba/ klu'i dbang po phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ shar dang byang gi sgor padma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/

lho dang nub kyi sgor padma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la khro bo rnams g.yas brkyang dang*/ khro bo'i lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang gis gnas shing*/ thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag na rdo rje ljang khu mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mos 'khyud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ e yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ nam mkha'i snying po nag po don grub lta bu la/ dri rdo rje ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ar yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ sa'i snying po dmar po rin chen dbang po lta bu la/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ o yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po 'od dpag med lta bu la/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mos 'khyud pa/ byang sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ al yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrib pa rnam sel ser po rnam snang lta bu la/ reg bya rdo rje ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ aṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ kun tu bzang po sngon po rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu la/ chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khus 'khyud pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang padma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing*/ thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /ā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las/ chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khu mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ kun tu bzang po sngon pos 'khyud pa/

nub sgo'i g.yon du zla'i steng du 'khod par 'gyur/ /ai yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs gyur pa las/ reg bya rdo rje ma nag mo don grub lta bu la/ sgrib pa rnam sel ser pos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ār yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mo rin chen dbang po lta bu la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar pos 'khyud pa/ bden bral du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ au yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/ sa'i snying po dmar pos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ āl yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ dri rdo rje ma ser mo rnam snang lta bu la/ nam mkha'i snying po nag pos 'khyud pa/ rlung mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ āḥyig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu la/ phyag na rdo rje ljang khus 'khyud pa/ byang sgo'i g.yon du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang padma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la padma'i gdan gyis gnas shing*/ shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de ltar na de rnams thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste/ sgrol ma/ bgegs mthar byed/ shin tu brtson 'grus ma/ nam mkha'i snying po/ reg bya rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ gos dkar mo/ shes rab mthar byed/ rmugs byed ma/ sa'i snying po/ ro rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/

phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ mā ma kī/ padma mthar byed/ khengs byed ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gzugs rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung*/ rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i padma dkar po/ me long*/ bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ gshin rje mthar byed/ rengs byed ma/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dri rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po g.yas zhal dkar zhal g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung*/ rdo rje'i lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang chos khams rdo rje ma rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra st+wa/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ sgra rdo rje ma ni rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra st+wa/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i dril bu/ /thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa'o/ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu la/ shar du dri ma dang phreng ba ma nag mo/ lhor bdug spos ma dang snang gsal ma dmar mo/ byang du bdud rtsi ma dang 'bras bu ma dkar mo/ nub tu sgeg mo dang bzhad ma ser mo/ steng du sgra ma dang gar ma ljang khu/ 'og tu glu ma dang 'dod ma sngon mo ste/ thams cad rang rang gi ming dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas thogs shing*/ gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/

/ thugs dkyil gyi lha mtha' dag sa bon kho na las bskyed kyang rung zhing*/ nus ma rnams dang*/ rdo rje bzhi rnams mngon byang lnga las gtso bo dang lhan cig bskyed chog go /de nas/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la rnal 'byor rnams spro bar bya ste/ ha yig las byung ba'i gri gug nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ tsar tsi ka nag mo la dbang po ser pos 'khyud pa shar gyi padma'i lte bar yi dwags dmar po la gnas pa dang*/ hi hī ya yi yaṃ rnams las byung ba'i gri gug nag po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jigs ma/ rlung shugs ma/ drag mo/ dus kyi mche ba ma/ me 'bar gdong ma/ rab gtum ma/ drag mig ma/ sna chen ma rnams kyang nag mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭwaṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ / kṣa yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ khyab 'jug ma nag mo la tshangs pa ser pos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams kyi padma'i lte bar mkha' lding la gnas pa dang*/ kṣi kṣī yā yī yaḥrnams las byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ g.yung mo/ rnam par rgyal ma/ sgyu ma/ grags ma/ bkra shis ma/ dpal ldan rgyal ma/ dpal ldan rgyal byed ma/ 'khor lo ma rnams kyang nag mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang be con/ g.yon gnyis kyis padma dang dung 'dzin pa'o/ /haḥyig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ phag mo dmar mo la drag po dkar pos 'khyud pa/ lho'i padma'i lte bar ma he la gnas pa dang*/ ru rl̥ raṃ rnams las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ keng rus ma/ gtsigs ma/ dus mtshan ma/
