rab khros gdong ma/ dus kyi lce ma/ nag mo/ drag mo/ gzugs ngan ma rnams kyang dmar mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis lcags sgrog dang phub 'dzin pa'o/ /kṣaḥyig las byung ba'i shakti dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhon nu ma dmar mo la tshogs bdag dkar pos 'khyud pa bden bral gyi padma'i lte bar rma bya la gnas pa dang*/ rū rl̥̄ raḥrnams las byung ba'i shakti dmar po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ padma ma/ rin chen 'phreng ba ma/ lus med ma/ gzhon nu ma/ ri dwags bdag pos 'gro ma/ mig bzang ma/ rul ma/ bzang mo rnams kyang dmar mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis shakti dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ / haṃ yig las byung ba'i rtse gsum dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ drag mo dkar mo la gshin rje dmar pos 'khyud pa/ byang gi padma'i lte bar khyu mchog la gnas pa dang*/ hu hū wa wi waṃ rnams las byung ba'i rtse gsum dkar po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ gau ri 'degs ma/ gaṃ gā ma/ rtag ma/ myur ma/ mtshon byed ma/ dmar ser ma/ nag mo rnams kyang dkar mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ltos 'gro 'dzin pa'o/ /kṣaṃ yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal mo dkar mo la gdong drug dmar pos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan gyi padma'i lte bar seng ge la gnas pa dang*/ kṣu kṣū wā wī waḥrnams £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ las byung ba'i padma dkar po brgyad

£© yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan dkar mo/ 'dzin ma/ zla ba'i ri mo can ma/ ri bong 'dzin zhal ma/ ngang pa'i mdog ma/ padma'i dbang mo/ skar mig ma/ dri med ri bong 'dzin ma rnams kyang dkar mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis padma dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis chu skyes dang rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /hā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang mo ser mo la bden bral nag pos 'khyud pa/ nub kyi padma'i lte bar glang po che la gnas pa dang*/ hl̥ hl̥̄ la li lu ll̥ laṃ rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'od/ bkra ba'i ri mo/ rdo rje'i lus ma/ gser ldan ma/ urba sī/ ram bha/ zug rngu med ma/ shin tu sgrol ma rnams kyang ser mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /kṣā yig las byung ba'i bar bu ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ tshangs ma ser mo la khyab 'jug nag pos 'khyud pa/ rlung mtshams kyi padma'i lte bar ngang pa la gnas pa dang*/ kṣl̥ kṣl̥̄ lā lī lū ll̥̄ laḥrnams las byung ba'i bar bu ser po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ mchod sbyin 'dod ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ padma'i spyan ma/ chu skyes ldan ma/ blo gros ma/ glu ma/ glog ma/ dran ma rnams kyang ser mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang*/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang*/ g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis padma dang tshangs pa'i dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis spyi blugs dang bar bu 'dzin pa'o/ /gtso mo brgyad po rnams ni sa ga'i stabs kyis gnas shing*/

bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs pa dang*/ 'khor rnams ni rol pa'i stabs can rang rang gi gtso mo la mngon du phyogs pa ste/ tshangs ma 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong bzhi ma/ gzhon nu ma 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong drug ma/ gzhan rnams gdong gcig ma/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i thabs brgyad ni sku'i lha chen rnams kyi skabs dang phyag mtshan 'dra ba'o/ / de nas/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la tshes kyi lha rnams spro bar bya ste/ nya nyi nyaṃ/ dzha dzhi dzhaṃ/ dza dzi dzaṃ/ tsha tshi tshaṃ/ tsa tsi tsaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri nag po rnams su gyur te/ tsaṃ dang las byung ba'i ral gri dag yongs su gyur pa las/ srin po nag po la dzaṛ rdo rje ma srin mo ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar gyi g.yas su padma'i lte bar yi dwags la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i nya rdo rje ma/ nyi rdo rje ma/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ nyaṃ/ dzha dzhi dzhaṃ/ dza dzi dzaṃ/ tsha tshi tshaṃ/ tsa tsi rdo rje ma rnams kyang nag mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis kyis phub dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ nag pa zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /

des rigs sgres te 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ / tsā tsī tsaḥ tshā tshī tshaḥ dzā dzī dzaḥ dzhā dzhī dzhaḥ nyā nyī nyaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dpag bsam gyi shing nag po rnams su gyur te/ nyaḥdang las byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing dag yongs su gyur pa las/ rlung lha nag po la rdo rje ma rab gtum ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams kyi padma'i lte bar ri dwags la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ tsā tshā dzā dzhā rdo rje ma rnams kyang nag mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dpag bsam gyi shing dang yongs 'du'i me tog g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu ind+ra nī la dang*/ utpal sngon po 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni dpyid kyi dus so/ / ṇa ṇi ṇaṃ/ ḍha ḍhi ḍhaṃ/ ḍa ḍi ḍaṃ/ ṭha ṭhi ṭhaṃ/ ṭa ṭi ṭaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mdung dmar po rnams su gyur te/ ṭaṃ dang las byung ba'i mdung dag yongs su gyur pa las/ /me lha dmar po la rdo rje ma chu lha mo dkar mos 'khyud pa lho'i g.yas su padma'i lte bar lug la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha rdo rje ma rnams kyang dmar mo gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis mdung dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis chu skyes dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ snron gyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /ṭā ṭī ṭaḥ ṭhā ṭhī ṭhaḥ ḍā ḍī ḍaḥ ḍhā ḍhī ḍhaḥ ṇā ṇī ṇaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shakti dmar po rnams su gyur te/ ṇaḥdang las byung ba'i shakti dag yongs su gyur pa las/ gdong drug dmar po la rdo rje ma dpal mo dkar mos 'khyud pa/

bden bral gyi padma'i lte bar rma bya la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ ṭā ṭhā ḍā ḍhā rdo rje ma rnams kyang dmar mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyi shakti dang mdung*/ g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang me long 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ chu stod kyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni sos ka'i dus so/ /ma mi maṃ/ bha bhi bhaṃ/ ba bi baṃ/ pha phi phaṃ/ pa pi paṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ zhags pa dkar po rnams su gyur te/ paṃ dang las byung ba'i zhags pa dag yongs su gyur pa las/ rgya mtsho dkar po la rdo rje ma phag mo dmar mos 'khyud pa/ byang gi g.yas su padma'i lte bar chu srin la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i ma bha ba phapl̥ rdo rje ma rnams kyang dkar mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis zhags pa dang rin po che/ g.yon gnyis kyis sbrul zhags dang zla ba chu shel gyi nor bu 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /pā pī paḥ phā phī phaḥ bā bī bū baḥ bhā bhī bhaḥ mā mī maḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dgra st+wa dkar po rnams su gyur te/ maḥdang las byung ba'i dgra st+wa dag yongs su gyur pa las/ tshogs bdag dkar po la rdo rje ma gzhon nu ma dmar mos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan gyi padma'i lte bar byi ba la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ pā phā bā bhā rdo rje ma rnams kyang dkar mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dgra st+wa dang rdo rje*/ g.yon gnyis kyis zhags pa dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/

khrums stod kyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni dbyar gyi dus so/ /na ni naṃ/ dha dhi dhaṃ/ da di du d-il daṃ/ tha thi thaṃ/ ta ti taṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje ser po rnams su gyur te/ taṃ dang las byung ba'i rdo rje dag yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang po ser po la rdo rje ma rlung lha mo nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub kyi g.yas su padma'i lte bar glang po che la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i na dha da tha rdo rje ma rnams kyang ser mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /tā tī taḥ thā thī thaḥ dā dī daḥ dhā dhī dhaḥ nā nī naḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ khab ser po rnams su gyur te/ naḥdang las byung ba'i khab dag yongs su gyur pa las/ mes po ser po la rdo rje ma glog ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ rlung mtshams kyi padma'i lte bar ngang pa la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ tā thā dā dhā rdo rje ma rnams kyang ser mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis khab dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis padma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni ston gyi dus so/ /ྈྐ ྈྐི sha shi sh-ir shu shaṃ/ ṣa ṣi ṣaṃ/ ྉྤ ྉྤི ྉྤཾ/ sa si saṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rtse gsum sngon po rnams su gyur te/ saṃ dang las byung ba'i rtse gsum dag yongs su gyur pa las/ drag po sngon po la rdo rje ma ri sras ma ljang khus 'khyud pa/

byang gi g.yon du padma'i lte bar khyu mchog la gnas pa dang*/ ༷mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i ྈྐ sha ṣa ྉྤ sl̥ rdo rje ma rnams kyang sngon mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis sbrul dang bcas pas kha ṭwāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ mgo'i zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /sā sī sū sl̥̄ saḥ ṣā ṣī shū ṣl̥̄ ṣaḥ shā shī shū shl̥̄ shaḥ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ be con sngon po rnams su gyur te/ ྈྐཿdang las byung ba'i be con dag yongs su gyur pa las/ ༵nor bdag sngon po la rdo rje ma nor gyi dbang mo ljang khus 'khyud pa/ nub kyi g.yon du padma'i lte bar glang po che la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ sā rdo rje ma rnams kyang sngon mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis nor bu dang be con/ g.yon gnyis kyis ne'u le dang padma 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni dgun stod kyi dus so/ /nga ngi ngaṃ*/ gha ghi ghū ghl̥ ghaṃ/ ga gi gaṃ/ kha khi khu khl̥ khaṃ/ ka ki kaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo ljang khu rnams su gyur te/ kaṃ dang las byung ba'i 'khor lo dag yongs su gyur pa las/ khyab 'jug ljang khu la rdo rje ma dpal mo sngon mos 'khyud pa/ shar gyi g.yon du padma'i lte bar mkha' lding la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i nga gha ga kha kl̥ rdo rje ma rnams kyang ljang khu/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dbyug tho/ g.yon gnyis kyis padma dang skye ba lnga pa'i dung 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/

mchu'i zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /kā kī kū k-ilā kaḥ khā khī khū khl̥̄ khaḥ gā gī gū gl̥̄ gaḥ ghā ghī ghū ghl̥̄ ghaḥ ngā ngī ngū ng-ilā ngaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbyug pa ljang khu rnams su gyur te/ ngaḥdang las byung ba'i dbyug pa dag yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje ljang khu la rdo rje ma gshin rje mo sngon mos 'khyud pa/ lho'i g.yon du padma'i lte bar ma he la gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ kā khā gā ghā rdo rje ma rnams kyang ljang khu gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyi dbyug pa dang ral gri g.yon gnyis kyis lcags sgrog dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te/ pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ dbo'i zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni dgun smad kyi dus so/ /gtso bo rnams ni rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs pa dang*/ 'khor rnams ni rol pa'i stabs can rang rang gi gtso bo la mngon du phyogs pa ste/ tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong bzhi pa/ gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong drug pa/ gzhan rnams gdong gcig pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa'o/ /sku'i sgo skyong spro bar bya ste/ ya yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa nag po yongs su gyur pa las khro bo dbyug sngon can nag po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyi phub dang ltos 'gro 'dzin pa la/ lā yig las byung ba'i 'od zer can ma ser mo stobs po che lta bus 'khyud pa/ shar sgor 'od zer can ma'i shing rta la gnas pa dang*/ ra yig las byung ba'i mda' dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa la/

wā yig las byung ba'i skul byed ma dkar mo mi g.yo ba lta bus 'khyud pa/ lho sgor tsun da'i shing rta la gnas pa dang*/ wa yig las byung ba'i gtun shing dkar po yongs su gyur pa las mi g.yo ba dkar po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis tho ba dang mdung*/ g.yon gnyis kyis padma dang me long 'dzin pa la/ rā yig las byung ba'i khro gnyer can ma dmar mo 'dod rgyal lta bus 'khyud pa/ byang sgor khro gnyer can gyi shing rta la gnas pa dang*/ la yig las byung ba'i be con ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ stobs po che ser po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis dung dang rin po che 'dzin pa la/ yā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje lcags sgrog ma nag mo dbyug sngon can lta bus 'khyud pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma'i shing rta la gnas pa dang*/ haṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ljang khu/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dgra st+wa dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis kyis sbrul zhags dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa la/ haḥyig las byung ba'i shin tu sngon mo gnod mdzes rgyal po lta bus 'khyud pa/ steng du shin tu sngon mo'i shing rta la gnas pa dang*/ ha yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ hā yig las byung ba'i drag spyan ma ljang khu gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba lta bus 'khyud pa/ 'og tu drag spyan ma'i shing rta la gnas pa ste/ khro bo yab yum de rnams thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ rab tu khros shing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ khro bo rnams g.yas brkyang dang*/ khro bo lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ / mi spro? na khro mo bcu po rnams kyi sa bon bor kyang rung ngo*/

/ sku'i stegs bu la rta 'bab kyi ka ba'i nang rol du klu rnams spro bar bya ste/ hya hyā las byung ba'i rgyal mtshan dag yongs su gyur pa las/ stobs kyi rgyu dang padma nag po la/ mkha' lding gdong ma dang*/ lce spyang gdong ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor zlum po nag po thig les mtshan pa la gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i bkra shis 'khyil pa dag yongs su gyur pa las/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po la/ 'ug gdong ma dang*/ stag gdong ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po bkra shis kyis mtshan pa la gnas pa dang*/ las byung ba'i padma dag yongs su gyur pa las/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po la/ bya rgod gdong ma dang*/ phag gdong ma dmar pos 'khyud pa/ byang sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zla gam dkar po padmas mtshan pa la gnas pa dang*/ hla hlā las byung ba'i rdo rje £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ ser po £© dag yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jog po dang padma chen po ser po la/ khwa gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa la gnas pa dang*/ steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ljang khu la rgyal ba ljang khu/ rdo rje mig mas 'khyud pa dang*/ 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sngon po la/ rnam par rgyal ba sngon po/ shin tu sngon mos 'khyud pas gnas pa ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /dur khrod 'khor lo'i steng du rab gtum ma rnams spro bar bya ste/

dang gri gug las byung ba'i khyi gdong ma nag mo la padma chen pos 'khyud pa/ shar gy-i dur khrod rtse mos 'bigs par bse'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang*/ dang gri gu las byung ba'i khwa gdong ma nag mo la 'jog pos 'khyud pa/ shar lho'i dur khrod lhag ma can du bhe ru ṇa ḍa'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang*/ dang gri gug las byung ba'i phag gdong ma dmar mo la rigs ldan gyis 'khyud pa/ lho'i dur khrod ro bsregs par dom gyi steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang*/ dang gri gug las byung ba'i bya rgod gdong ma dmar mo la mtha' yas kyis 'khyud pa/ bden bral gyi dur khrod drag po'i g.yul du khrung khrung gi steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang*/ dang gri gug las byung ba'i stag gdong ma dkar mo la dung skyong gis 'khyud pa/ byang gi dur khrod rul bar 'bri'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang*/ dang gri gug las byung ba'i 'ug gdong ma dkar mo la nor rgyas kyis 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan gyi dur khrod byis pa shi bar bya ma byi'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang*/ gri gug las byung ba'i lce spyang gdong ma ser mo la padmas 'khyud pa/ nub kyi dur khrod rnag gi drir seng ge'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang*/

gri gug las byung ba'i mkha' lding gdong ma ser mo la stobs kyi rgyus 'khyud pa/ rlung gi dur khrod sbrul gyis bzung bar mig sngon gyi steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang*/ steng dang 'og tu yang sngon mo dang*/ rdo rje'i mig ma ljang khu dang sngon mo la rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ rgyal ba dag gis 'khyud pa/ shing rta ljang khu dang sngon po la gnas pa ste/ thams cad zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas shing*/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga brgyan pa/ mi mgo'i 'phreng ba mgul du 'phyang ba/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum ma/ phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sa bon dang mtshan ma sna tshogs pa las byung ba'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi dang*/ gza' bcu dang dhru wa dang*/ a gast+ya la sogs pa'i drang srong rnams dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa skar ma thams cad dang*/ khyim bcu gnyis dang*/ cha bcu drug dang*/ phyogs bcu skyong ba dang*/ dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ nag po chen po dang*/ dril bu'i rna ba can dang*/ bhring gi ni dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ pho nya thams cad dang*/ 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*/ skra'i grangs kyi grub pa rnams/ dbyibs dang*/ kha dog dang*/ mtshan ma sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ de nas/ gsung gi stegs bu la 'dod ma rnams spro bar bya ste/ tsaḥtshaḥdzaḥdzhaḥnyaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol ma las byung ba dbye bar 'dod ma dang*/ reg bya rdau rje ma las byung ba gos 'dod ma dang*/ khyab 'jug ma las byung ba mchil ma ma dor bar 'dod ma dang*/ lcags sgrog ma las byung ba reg bya 'dod ma dang*/ khwa gdong ma las byung ba lhag ma za bar 'dod ma rnams shar sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ ṭaḥṭhaḥḍaḥḍhaḥṇaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gos dkar mo las byung ba bskyod par 'dod ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma las byung ba zas 'dod ma dang*/

gzhon nu ma las byung ba gar 'dod ma dang*/ khro gnyer can ma las byung ba 'gugs par 'dod ma dang*/ bya rgod gdong ma las byung ba'i g.yul 'dod ma rnams lho sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ paḥphaḥbaḥbhaḥmaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mā ma kī las byung ba rgyas par 'dod ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma las byung ba rgyan 'dod ma dang*/ dpal mo las byung ba rgyal srid 'dod ma dang*/ tsun dā las byung ba 'ching bar 'dod ma dang*/ 'ug gdong ma las byung ba byis pa sdigs par 'dod ma byang sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ taḥthaḥdaḥdhaḥnaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ spyan ma las byung ba rengs par 'dod ma dang*/ dri rdo rje ma las byung ba dri 'dod ma dang*/ tshangs ma las byung ba chu la rkyal bar 'dod ma dang*/ 'od zer can ma las byung ba phur bus 'debs par 'dod ma dang*/ mkha' lding gdong ma las byung ba sbrul 'ching bar 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa ste/ lnga pa rnams ni stegs bu'i zur la gnas pa'o/ /saḥྉྤཿṣaḥshaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shin tu sngon mo las byung ba kun tu gdung bar 'dod ma dang*/ shin tu brtson 'grus ma las byung ba bskrod par 'dod ma dang*/ tsar tsī kā las byung ba lus 'khrug par 'dod ma dang*/ khyi gdong ma las byung ba yan lag bskyod par 'dod ma rnams shar sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang ྈྐཿkaḥkhaḥgaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ drag spyan ma las byung ba rgyug par 'dod ma dang*/ rmugs byed pa las byung ba skems par 'dod ma dang*/ phag mo las byung ba lus kyi dri ma 'dod ma dang*/ phag gdong ma las byung ba bshang gci zag par 'dod ma rnams lho sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ ghaḥngaḥlaḥwaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma las byung ba rol mo 'dod ma dang*/ khengs byed pa las byung ma 'jam par smra bar 'dod ma dang*/

drag mo las byung ba mal stan 'dod ma dang*/ stag gdong ma las byung ba rtsod pa mang po 'dod ma rnams byang sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ raḥyaḥhaḥkṣaḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ chos kyi khams ma las byung ba 'khrig par 'dod ma dang*/ rengs byed ma las byung ba gnyen bdun gdod ma dang*/ dbang mo las byung ba mal stan bsnyes par 'dod ma dang*/ lcai spyang gdong ma las byung ba sems can slu bar 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa'o/ / de nas/ sku'i stegs bu la phyir 'dod ma rnams spro ba ni/ tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ dzñaṃ nyaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol ma las byung ba dbye bar mi 'dod ma dang*/ reg bya rdo rje ma las byung ba gos mi 'dod ma dang*/ khyab 'jug ma las byung ba mchil ma 'dor bar mi 'dod ma dang*/ lcags sgrog ma las byung ba reg bya mi 'dod ma dang*/ khwa gdong ma las byung ba lhag ma za bar mi 'dod ma rnams shar sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gos dkar mo las byung ba skyod par mi 'dod ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma las byung ba zas mi 'dod ma dang*/ gzhon nu ma las byung ba gar mi 'dod ma dang*/ khro gnyer can ma las byung ba 'gugs par mi 'dod ma dang*/ bya rgod gdong ma las byung ba g.yul mi 'dod ma rnams lho sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mā ma kī las byung ba rgyas par mi 'dod ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma las byung ba rgyan mi 'dod ma dang*/ dpal mo las byung ba rgyal srid mi 'dod ma dang*/ tsun dā las byung ba 'ching bar mi 'dod ma dang*/ 'ug gdong ma las byung ba byis pa sdig par mi 'dod ma rnams byang sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/

spyan ma las byung ba rengs par mi 'dod ma dang*/ dri rdo rje ma las byung ba dri mi 'dod mi dang*/ tshangs ma las byung ba chu la rkyal bar mi 'dod ma dang*/ 'od zer can ma las byung ba phur bus 'debs par mi 'dod ma dang*/ mkha' lding gdong ma las byung ba sbrul 'ching bar mi 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa ste/ lnga pa rnams ni stegs bu'i zur la gnas pa'o/ /saṃ ྉྤཾ ṣaṃ shaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shin tu sngon mo las byung ba kun tu gdung bar mi 'dod ma dang*/ shin tu brtson 'grus ma las byung ba bskrod par mi 'dod ma dang*/ tsar tsī ka las byung ba lus 'khrug par mi 'dod ma dang*/ khyi gdong ma las byung ba yan lag bskyod par mi 'dod ma rnams shar sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ ྈྐཾ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ drag spyan ma las byung ba rgyug par mi 'dod ma dang*/ rmugs byed ma las byung ba skems par mi 'dod ma dang*/ phag mo las byung ba lus kyi dri ma mi 'dod ma dang*/ phag gdong ma las byung ba bshang gci zag par mi 'dod ma rnams lho sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ ghaṃ ngaṃ laṃ waṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma las byung ba rol mo mi 'dod ma dang*/ khengs byed ma las byung ba 'jal par smra bar mi 'dod ma dang*/ drag mo las byung ba mal stan mi 'dod ma dang*/ stag gdong ma las byung brtsod pa mang po mi 'dod ma rnams byang sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang*/ raṃ yaṃ haṃ kṣaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ chos kyi khams ma las byung ba 'khrig pa mi 'dod ma dang*/ rengs byed ma las byung ma gnyen 'dun mi 'dod ma dang*/ dbang mo las byung ba mal stan bsnyes par mi 'dod ma dang*/ lce spyang gdong ma las byung ba sems can bslu bar mi 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa'o/

/de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lor rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ <shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o// > su bi shuddha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ gnyis pa snying rje'i dbang bskur ba ni/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa dag gis 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor chen por bcug par gyur/ de nas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa thams cad bkug nas rang gi snying khar rab tu zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i rdo rje las spros nas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer rnams kyis reg pa'i sems can de rnams mchog gi dga' ba dang bde bas gang ba'i lha'i sku thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid/ zhal dang sku mdog la sogs pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa dang*/ de dag re re zhing yang skad cig gis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ kṣa kṣi kṣu kṣl̥ las phung po lnga rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lnga dang*/ kṣā kṣī kṣū kṣl̥̄ las khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lnga dang*/ kṣa kṣe kṣo kṣal kṣaṃ las dbang po drug rnam par dag pa sems dpa' drug dang*/ kṣā kṣāai kṣār kṣāau kṣāl kṣaḥlas yul drug rnam par dag pa sems ma drug dang*/ las kyi dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa khro bo lnga dang*/ las kyi dbang po'i yul lnga rnam par dag pa khro mo lnga ste/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur te/ slar yang de rnams rang rang zhing du gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog ni/

dang por lte ba dang gtsug tor gyi a wa dhū tī'i lam du hoḥyig dag dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga rnams su sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams las byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'khod par gyur/ hoḥyig dus kyi me'i 'od zer gyis steng dang 'og nas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams bzhus te/ gtum mo shes rab kyi chags pas yab yum gnyis zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur/ lha mo rnams kyis glu dag mdzad de bcom ldan khyod ni sems can kun la phan par mdzad pa po/ bdag cag srungs shig lha mi'i bla ma rdo rje ldan pa 'dod pa don gnyer rnams la 'dod pa mdzod/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ / rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ / dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod//mā ma kī bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bu'i gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas/ /'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i glu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i slad du bskul ba las/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de/ 'gro ba mthar dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas/ gzhan gyi don du slar yang bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/

rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan zhing*/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo sna tshogs yum gyi 'khyud pa'i skur gyur pa dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la nus ma brgyad/ phyi rol kyi grwa bzhi la rdo rje bzhi dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis bzhengs par gyur pa ni/ zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag gi padma stong pa drug dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma bsreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pas mnan pa'i srid med srid mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍa ma ru/ /tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang*/ /dril bu phub dang kha ṭwaṃ thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ / pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / stag lpags dang ni rdo rje'i rgyan ldan rdo rje'i sku can bde ba che/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum gyis kun nas rab 'khyud gser mdog ma/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gri gug lcags kyu ḍa ma ru dang bgrang 'phreng dang*/ /thod pa zhags pa padma dkar dang rin chen 'dzin mar bcas la 'dud/ /nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan dan gur gum dang ni ga bur snod/ /dril bu padma yongs 'du'i me tog sna tshogs me tog 'phreng ldan ma/ /dmar mo'i g.yas na mar me do shal cod pan dang ni gdu bu ste/ /g.yon na gos dang ska rags dang ni rin chen rna rgyan rkang gdub 'dzin/ /dkar mo'i g.yas na 'o ma chu dang sman mchog chang gi snod rnams te/ /g.yon na bdud rtsi grub pa'i bcud dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bras chan snod/ /ser mo 'bar ma dung dang gling bu nor bu dang ni ḍa ma ru/

/pi waṃ rnga dang 'khar rnga zangs dung rang phyogs gtso bo'i zhal ldan ma/ /de dag dang mtshungs du ba smig rgyu me khyer dang ni mar me ma/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad ldan phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan dang ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gags la 'dud/ /tshad med rnam thar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang dang bsnyen sgrub dga' ba bzhes/ /lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le gnas skabs rnam bzhi rnam dag pa/ /skad cig mkhyen pa sku dang rdo rje byang chub rnam bzhi sems dpa' bzhi/ /chos kyi dung dang gaṇḍī nor bu dpag bsam shing la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de rnams sngon bzhin bskyed kyang chog go / yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du rang gi lus la rab tu bcug nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ aṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gugadagra st+wa/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin mas 'khyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por zhugs par gyur/ i ī las byung pa'i ral gri nag po dag dang*/ ṛ ṝ las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag dang*/ u ū las byung ba'i padma dkar po dag dang*/ l̥ l̥̄ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag dang*/
hi hī

hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥrnams so/ /yaṃ yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po/ raṃ yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po/ waṃ yig las byung ba'i padma dkar po/ laṃ yig las byung ba'i tho ba ser po/ a aṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag dang*/ e ai las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag dang*/ ar ār las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag dang*/ o au las byung ba'i padma dkar po dag dang*/ /al āl las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag dang*/ ā aḥlas byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu sngon po dag dang*/ ha hi hī ya yi yaṃ rnams las byung ba'i gri gug nag po rnams dang*/ kṣa kṣi kṣī yā yī yaḥrnams las byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po rnams dang*/ haḥ ra ri ru ru rl̥ raṃ rnams las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po rnams dang*/ kṣaḥ rā rī rū rl̥̄ raḥrnams las byung ba'i shakti dmar po rnams dang*/ haṃ hu hū wa wi waṃ rnams las byung ba'i rtse gsum dkar po rnams dang*/ kṣaṃ kṣu kṣū wā wī waḥ rnams las byung ba'i padma dkar po rnams dang*/ hā hl̥ hl̥̄ la li lu ll̥ laṃ rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po rnams dang*/ kṣā kṣl̥ kṣl̥̄ lā lī lū ll̥̄ laḥ rnams las byung ba'i bar bu ser po rnams dang*/ nya nyi nyaṃ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i ral gri nag po rnams dang*/ tsā tsī tsāṃḥl sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing nag po rnams dang*/ ṇa ṇi ṇaṃ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i mdung dmar po rnams dang*/ ṭā ṭī ṭaḥ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i shakti dmar po rnams dang*/ ma mi maṃ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i zhags pa dkar po rnams dang*/ pā pī pāḥ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i dgra st+wa dkar po rnams dang*/ na ni naṃ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po rnams dang*/ tā tī taḥl sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i khab ser po rnams dang*/ ྈྐ ྈྐི ྈྐཾ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i rtse gsum sngon po rnams dang*/

sā sī sū sl̥̄ saṃ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i be con sngon po rnams dang*/ nga ngi ngaṃ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i 'khor lo ljang khu rnams dang*/ kā kī kū kl̥̄ kaḥ la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i dbyug pa ljang khu rnams dang*/ ya ra la wa haṃ hā rnams las byung ba'i dbyug pa dang*/ mda' dang*/ gtun shing dang*/ be con dang*/ rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang*/ hya hyā hla hlā rnams byung ba'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ bkra shis 'khyil pa dang*/ padma dang*/ rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang*/ rnams las byung ba'i gri gug phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang*/ tsaḥtshaḥdzaḥdzñaḥnyaḥ ṭaḥṭhaḥḍaḥḍhaḥṇaḥ paḥphaḥbaḥbhaḥmaḥ taḥthaḥdaḥdhaḥnaḥ saḥྉྤཿṣaḥshaḥྈྐཿ kaḥkhaḥgaḥghaḥngaḥ laḥwaḥraḥyaḥhaḥkṣaḥrnams dang*/ tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ dzhaṃ nyaṃ/ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ/ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ/ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ/ saṃ ྉྤཾ ṣaṃ shaṃ ྈྐཾ/ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ngaṃ*/ laṃ waṃ raṃ yaṃ haṃ kṣaṃ rnams te/ de rnams so sor yongs su gyur pa las/ khu khrag rkang dang khrag gi tshogs can dri chu dri chen rab 'gags pas/ / zhes pa nas/ srid gsum dang ba mngon du byed gyur cig/ ces pa'i bar/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i bstod chen gyi tshig rnams 'don zhing*/ spros pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal phyag gsal gdab bo/ /ci ste rgyas pa la mngon par dga' bas ni gtso bo sa bon phyag mtshan las bskyed pa dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can du byed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bstim pa ste/ khyad par de tsam ma gtogs/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lha mo sangs rgyas rig ma shing dang bcas shing bum pa dang bcas rgyal ba yi ni dag pa'i sku/ /khro bo'i dbang po byang chub sems dpa' nges par ro yi rdo rje ma ni chos kyi sku de nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams longs spyod sku ste rab mchog shing rta la gnas lha ni nyi mar rab grags pa/

/klu ni rgyal po rnams dang rab gtum ma rnams 'khor dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi ni sprul pa'i sku/ /de bzhin slar yang rgyal ba'i sku ni dbye ba gnyis su 'gyur te phyi rol dag dang nang du yang*/ /mngal nas skyes pa ji lta ba nyid de bzhin kho nar dkyil 'khor la ni nges par rab tu 'gyur/ /ston pa lha mo sogs dang bum pa lhan skyes rgyal ba'i sku ste dkyil 'khor snying po'i dbus su'o/ /sangs rgyas la sogs chos kyi sku ste nges par ro yi rdo rje ma sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ / khro bo sprul pa'i sku ru 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis dkyil 'khor gyi ni snying por yang dag gnas/ /phyi rol tu ni tsā muṇa ḍā la sogs pa lha mo brgyad po 'khor dang bcas pa dag pa'i sku/ /lha la sogs pa chos kyi sku ste mtha' dag gdengs can rigs kyang 'dir ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /gtum mo rnams ni sprul pa'i skur 'gyur mi yi bdag po sems can kun gyi don gyi slad du'o/ / lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye ba'i dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur mi yi bdag /nyin zhag so so rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis sna tshogs yum ni sems kyi rnam pa nyin mtshan min/ /rlung gi dag pas du ba la sogs rang gi snying ga'i padmar rtsa yi 'khor lo la gnas rnams/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis drag po chung mar bcas pa khyab bdag zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud kyi tshogs kyis bdud/ / de bzhin dung dang gaṇḍī nor bu ljon pa zhes pa dag kyang sku yi rdo rje la sogs kyis/ /bum pa brgyad ni bdud rtsi'i yan lag gis te rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa byang chub sems sogs kyis/ /'du byed don yod grub pa tshor ba dri med nor bu'i phyag dang 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ /gzugs ni 'khor lo can no ri bong can dang stobs khrag bshang ba gci ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /lha mo drug ni khams rnams kyis te yul dang yul can rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag rgyar bcas/

/khro bo lnga ni stobs rnams kyis te nges par slar yang gzhan pa lnga ni dbang po gzhan rnams kyis/ /tsā muṇā ḍā sogs thun brgyad kyis te padma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams nyi ma'i dus sbyor chu tshod kyis/ /lha min la sogs nyi ma'i zla bas padma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams chu tshod dbugs kyi grangs kyis so/ / gsang bar mi bdag nyis 'gyur chu tshod rnams kyis klu rnams dang ni gtum mo rnams kyang rnam par dag/de bzhin 'dod ma la sogs de dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis lus kyi bya ba rnam par dag/sgra rnams kyis ni grub pa mtha' dag ba spu rnams kyis dur khrod sa gzhi la gnas 'byung po'i tshogs/ /de nyid rnams kyis gtso bo'i mtshon cha rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis khams kyi phyi yi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje nang gi phyag rgya rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du yang dag gnas pa'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje can dang sna tshogs yum ni rnam gsum srid gnas 'gyur med ye shes sbyor las so/ / mdor bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ sku yi rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i sku ni zung du 'gyur te sogs dang*/ dpal ldan dag pa las ni chos skur 'gyur te/ sogs kyang brjod par bya ste/ sgrub thabs ma mo las 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de nas/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs zhal bzhi pa 'jigs pa'i sku can/ rab tu bzhad cing mche ba phyir gtsigs pa/ sgra drag po sgrog pa/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ shes rab dang thabs las byung ba/ gtso bo bzhin du mtshon cha rnams dang bcas pa/ glang po che'i pags pa'i gos can/ phyag rgya dang ldan zhing mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ thod pa lnga dang*/ mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa nam mkha'i khams su spros te/

'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi lte bar rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing*/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams rdo rje zhags pas bcings nas mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis sdigs pa gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥ khro bo'i dbang po slar yang rang nyid la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ badzra puṣpaṃ/ badzra dhū paṃ/ badzra dī paṃ/ badzra nai we tyaṃ/ badzra akṣa taṃ/ badzra lā syaṃ/ badzra hā syaṃ/ badzra wā tyaṃ/ badzra nṛ tyaṃ/ badzra gī tāṃ/ badzra kā maṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ hūṃ waṃ hoḥhi/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar huṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ dpral bar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sku rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ padma/ g.yon pa gsum gyis ral gri dril bu/ nor bu 'dzin cing rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa dang*/ mgrin par ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ āḥlas byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gsung rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis padma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum gyis nor bu/ dril bu/ ral gri 'dzin cing*/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa dang*/ snying gar aṃ las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ padma/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dril bu/ ral gri/

nor bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa rnams 'khod pa las rab tu spros te/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas/ slar yang mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ sku'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang*/ gsung rdo rje dang*/ thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar gyur/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rdo rje dang*/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsung rdo rje dang*/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /gsung gi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ / phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /gsung gi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ / dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlabs shing*/

rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ <de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//> sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ shes rab kyi lte bar hoḥlas sku rdo rje/ gsang bar swā las gsung rdo rje/ gtsug tor du hā las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ bsdu na dbang bskur ba de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas par spro na snying ga'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ dbang bdun gyi gsol ba gdab pa'i sngags dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i sngags nga rgyal bzung ba dang bcas pa sngags dbang gi tshul gyis blang bar bya la/ dbang gong rnams ni phra thig gi rnal 'byor las 'grub pa'i phyir skabs 'dir mi bzhed do/ /rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang*/ mthar/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ rgyas gdab par gyur pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad la mi bskyod pa dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan la 'od dpag med dang*/ don yod grub pa la rin chen dbang pos rgyas btab par gyur pa/ dag pa'i phung po chos gos dang gtsug tor 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i rigs las byung ba ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa dang*/ 'du byed kyi rigs las byung ba nag po rnams la don yod grub pa dang*/ tshor ba'i rigs las byung ba dmar po rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ 'du shes kyi rigs las byung ba dkar po rnams la snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ gzugs kyi rigs las byung ba ser po rnams la snang mdzad dang*/ ye shes kyi rigs las byung ba sngon po rnams la rdo rje sems dpas rgyas gdab/ lha thams cad kyi gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la a yig mi bskyod pa dang*/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la i yig don yod grub pa dang*/

mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ yig rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la u yig snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la l̥ yig rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la aṃ yig rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab/ lha rnams ky-i lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor rnams su sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams la/ l̥ u ṛ i a'o/ /lha rnams kyi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams su zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dus me'i dkyil 'khor rnams la oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ'o// rdo rje nor bur gzhom du med pa'i a yig go / gsum pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las lte ba'i hoḥyig glog dang mtshungs pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bar gyur pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rang bzhin g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor phung po lnga'i rlung dang*/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rang bzhin g.yas kyi dkyil 'khor khams lnga'i rlung rnams bsregs shing*/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams kyang gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams la 'jug pa bsregs nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba las glo bur du thig le'i rgyun babs pas/ mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba/ snying gar sleb pas mchog dga'/ lte bar khyad par gyi dga' ba/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du byas/ oṃ dzñā na pū dza

<ye shes kyi dga' bas > a nu rakto <rjes su chags pa'i > swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ <rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//> slar yang ji ltar byon pa de bzhin du steng du gshegs pas/ lte bar rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras su lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang*/ snyi gar rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang*/ mgrin par skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ dpral bar dri ma dang bral ba'i 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rnams mngon du byas/ oṃ <de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' nga gdul dka' ba 'dul ba po/> sarba ta thā ga tā a dhi pa ti badzra satwā haṃ dur dānta da ma ka huṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas oṃ badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha sogs kyis mchod/ stong nyid snying rje sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis gong bzhin bstod/ de nas lha sku la sems 'dzin pa'am bzlas pa bya'o/ /de yang da ltar lag len la snying po gtso bor bzla bar snang zhing*/ rtsa sngags kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /gzhan yang mtshan sngags las lhag pa ni sku'i sngags so/ / oṃ kā la tsākra ya huṃ swāhā/ gsung gi sngags so/ / oṃ kāṃ swāhā/ thugs kyi sngags so/ /yang rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying dang*/ sa bon rnams ni sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ye shes kyi yang bzlas pa'o/ / oṃ phaṭa/ bsnun pa dang*/ oṃ huṃ/ dbab pa dang*/ oṃ bau ṣaṭa/ bsreg pa dang*/ oṃ na maḥ bslang ba dang*/ oṃ lkāḥswāhā/ rgyas pa dang*/ oṃ kāṃ wa ṣaṭa/ mnyes pa ste/ 'bum 'bum bzla'o/ /de rnams kyang thugs kyi bzlas pa'o/ /de nas oṃ kā la tsākra ya swāhā/ 'bum phrag bcu bzla'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i sngags/ oṃ swāhā/ zhes pa bye ba bzlas pas bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /yang na oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ zhes pa'am/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrāḥ zhes pa rnams gang yang rung ba zhig bye bar bzlas pas kyang bsnyen pa'o/

/ oṃ <rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo//> na mo badzra satwā ya/ na mo buddha bo dhi satwe bhyaḥ <sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//> na mo badzra kro dha in dra rā dze bhyaḥ <rdo rje khro bo'i dbang po'i rgyal po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//> na mo bi shwa mā tre/ <sna tshogs yum la phyag 'tshal lo//> na mo buddha bo dhi satwa de wī bhyaḥ <sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//> na mo badzra ḍā ki nī bhyaḥ <rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//> oṃ na mo bha ga wa te kā la tsakrā ya/ 13lt; bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo//> badzra bhai ra ba bhī kā rā ya/ 23lt;rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa la/> mahā in dra nī la barṇa sha rī rā ya/ 3 <dbang po'i sngon po chen po'i kha dog gi sku la/> mā ra klai sha hṛ da yā krān ta <bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i snying gar mnan pa > si ta raka ta tsa ra ṇā ya/ 43lt;dkar po dang dmar po'i zhabs la/> kṛṣṇa raka ta si ta kaṇa ṭhā ya/ 53lt;nag po dmar po dkar po'i mgrin pa la/> nī la si ta pī ta raka ta <sngon po dkar po ser po dmar po > daṃṣtā ka rā lo <mche ba gtsigs pa > gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ 63lt;drag cing 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal la/> kriṣṇa raka ta si ta <nag po dmar po dkar po'i > sa bye ta ra skan dhā ya/ 7 <g.yas dang cig shos kyi phrag pa la/> dwā da sha bhū dzā ya/ 8 <bcu gnyis kyi dpung pa la/> ṣaṭa biṃ sha ti ka rā ya/ 93lt;drug dang nyi shu'i phyag la/> badzra <rdo rje > khaḍa ga <ral gri3gt; tri shū la/ <rtse gsum > kar ti kā <gri gug > bā ṇa/ <mda' > aṃ ku sha <lcags kyuu > ḍa ma ru ka <cang te'i > mud ga ra/ <tho ba > tsakra/ <'khor lo > kun ta/ <mdung > daṇa ḍa/ <dbyug pa > par shu/ <dgra st+wa > badzra ghaṇa ḍā/ <rdo rje'i dril bu > khe ṭa/ <phub > kha ṭwāṃ ga <kha ṭwāṃ ga3gt; ka pā la/ <thod pa > tsā pa/

rkang pa dang lag pa'i sor mo'i tshigs rnams su klu dang rab gtum mo rnams gshegs su gsol/ de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug na/ smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa yang brjod nas/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na yang*/ nyer bsdu'i rjes nyid la bya ste/ gtor ma bshams/ oṃ phreṃ badzra ḍā ki nī/ badzra dhā twī shwā rī/ ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bya bi sho dha ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi bi sho dha ya huṃ phreṃ phaṭa ces pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las mi mgo'i sgyaid bu gsum la gnas pa'i oṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang gi dbus su a las byang sems/ shar du i las rkang dmar/ lhor ṛ las rakta/ byang du u las dri chu/ nub du l̥ las dri chen/ rlung mtshams su l̥̄ las glang po che'i sha dbang ldan du ū las ba glang gi sha bden bral du ṝ las rta'i sha me mtshams su ī las khyi'i sha dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sha rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ badzra tsand+ra sogs gong bzhin/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i āḥgasung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadzra sūrya sogs/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i huṃ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od kyis rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro nus mthu gzi brjid phun tshogs pa 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ hūṃ badzra a na

la sogs/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i hoḥyig ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo'i des 'od zer gyis zag med ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma sogs gong bzhin brjod pa ni gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /'di ni mtshon pa ste/ gtor ma dang nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas pa ni 'di ltar bya la/ 'bring po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin dang*/ bsdus pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pa tsam yin zhing*/ oṃ phreṃ badzra ḍā ki nī sogs kyi sngags de kho nas kyang rdzas mtha' dag byin gyis brlob pa ste/ 'di yang bsdus pa'o/ /de nas mgron spyan drang pa ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa sras bcas g.yog 'khor dang*/ /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis skor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*/ /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ha hā hi hī badzra bhai ra wa/ ā karṣa ya ā karṣa ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ bhandha ya/ bhandha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī hri da ya huṃ hūṃ phreṃ phreṃ phaṭa/ ces pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha na maḥ nas/ kā maṃ gyi bar brjod/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ shrī kā lā tsakrā badzra bhai ra wa bhī ka rā ya/ zhes 'don pa spos la/ sde drug bsrung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gtor la 'bul tshul bsrung 'khor skabs bzhin te/ rgyal ba rigs drug go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa'i bar ro/ /bar 'dir sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la'ang phul nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra ḍā ki nā bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ gandhaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ akṣa taṃ/ zhes sogs yul gyi bdag po'i gtor sngags dang 'dra bas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma phul/

sngon 'gro'i skabs su brjod pa ltar/ yul gyi bdag po dang*/ grong gi bdag po la yang 'bul te/ a pa ra sthā naṃ gatstsha gatstsha swāhā/ zhes pa'i dod du/ swa sthā naṃ gatstsha gatstsha swāhā/ zhes sgyur ba ni khyad par ro/ /spro na mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ mkha' 'gro lnga bstod dang*/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ / sogs dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs bya/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog de dag gi mthar/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang*/ /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang*/ /sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun du ni 'ching byed pa/ /de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyi shis pa brjod/ yig brgya'i mthar/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang nyid la thim/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyis lhan skyes bde ba mchog bsgoms te/ /'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku 'di chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi padma la gtugs shing*/ /dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin du mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnams kyis ni shes rab ye shes thob par gyur 'di ji lta bar/ /rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e waṃ nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa/ dai rnams lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ba min par 'ong gyur cig

/rnal 'byor bdag cag rnal 'byor ma thob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur na yang*/ /dpal ldan mi yi 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan par skye ba dang*/ /sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun tu 'dzin pa dang*/ /ye shes thob nas mi zad mchog gi gnas su rab bgrod slar yang gang du'ang skye ldan min gyur cig /dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang ltos 'gro'i bdag dang chom rkun zhags pas 'ching*/ /chu gter 'khrugs dang sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ / dbul dang bud med dang bral mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs dang rdo rje ltung dang don nyams rnams/ /bdag gis rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni gsal bar dran pa'i mthu las rab tu nyams gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / dus kyi 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med dus kyi 'khor lo ston/ /bla ma la gus snying brtse ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*/ btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam za can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ / des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces sogs smon lam ci rigs par gdab po/ gzhan yang kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ gnyid kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa rnams la'ang nan tan du bya ste/ bla ma'i zhal snga las rgyud don zhib mor mnyan pa dang*/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing las shes par bya zhing*/ sgrub thabs kyi go don zhib mo mtha' dag kyang ngo*/

/khyad par nges don mthar thug dang 'brel ba'i lugs 'di nyid dang bka' srol 'di nyid la/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dpa' bzang po zhes mtshan brjod par dka' ba de nyid rnam pa kun tu tshad mar byed dgos te/ shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po ston pa gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid kyis nye bar sbyar ba'i sgrub thabs rim pa drug yod pa rnams blta ba dang*/ nyan pa dang*/ bsam pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas nges pa gting tshugs par byas nas/ slad kyi dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi bskyed rim ston byed yan lag dang bcas pa rnams la nan tan du byas na/ blun po rdzun gyi man ngag la skyabs 'tshol ba dang*/ mkhas pa glegs bam mthong bas nga rgyal ba rnams kyis rang bzos ma bslad par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam ma nor ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa'i thabs 'di yang*/ sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung dang bye brag ma mchis pa de kho na'i dgongs don gzhir bzhag nas/ ngag 'don rnams chos rje yab sras kyi gsung las ji ltar brjod pa bde ba dag blangs shing*/ sgrub thabs kyi tshig gi dngos bstan la med kyang*/ phyag len las 'byung ba gsung gzhan las dpags na/ dgongs don la yod nges pa rnams kyis cung zad kha bskang ba yin no/ /gang 'dir gcig tu rang dga'i blo ngor nas/ /'phags pa'i gsung nyid dpang du byas nas bsdus/ /de ltar lags kyang 'khrul ba'i cha mchis na/ /bdag gis nongs pa mkhas la bzod par gsol/ /'di la gang gi lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /nye bar bskul dang mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar dang*/ /bdag gis 'bad las bsod nams gang skyes pa/ /de yang 'gro ba'i byang chub don du bsngo/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing la 'jug pa zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ don gnyer can du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu rtsa bdun pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o//
